method: 6 个子任务按章节逐条抽取（只抄原文、带原文摘录与 PDF 页码），程序逐条核对摘录是否出现在所标页；图 4-1 人工读图
fields: id, facility, aspect, category(hard/sizing/check/process), parameter, operator, value, unit, condition, modal(shall/should/may/none), section, vol, pdf_page, quote, rule_zh, l2s_use(filter/sizing/cost/report_only), machine_checkable, verify, status

items.rule_zh: 如认为偏离手册对项目有利，须取得 DEPARTMENT 书面批准并提交足够详细的支撑文件。
items.quote: Where a Developer or other party believes that a change to the Manual may be advantageous for a particular project, the written approval of DEPARTMENT shall be sought.

items.rule_zh: 任何设计报审须由合格咨询方提交，按第 8 节分阶段报送场地布置及排水方案。
items.quote: Any design submittal shall be by a qualified Consultant. The Consultant shall submit his proposals for the site layout and associated surface water an d sub -soil drainage to DEPARTMENT in the stages and level of detail set out in Section 8.

items.rule_zh: DEPARTMENT 设计批准不保证资产被接收。
items.quote: It should be noted that DEPARTMENT design approval does not guarantee taking over of assets

items.rule_zh: 手册适用于永久工程，也包括长期方案落实前可能需要的临时调蓄等过渡措施。
items.quote: This also includes the design of any interim measures, such as temporary storage, which may be required until a long-term solution i s available.

items.rule_zh: 鼓励创新、韧性、可持续排水（SuDS）方案，但须向 DEPARTMENT 提交足够详细的支撑文件以便评估。
items.quote: Documentation in support of this shall be submitted to DEPARTMENT in sufficient detail to allow the proposal to be appraised.

items.rule_zh: 方案须考虑现状管网、规划干管、新开发区、新建公路、露天区坡面流、灌溉余水、施工降水排水及地下水控制排水等所有来水。
items.quote: The Consultant shall take account of all the above when preparing his drainage proposals.

items.rule_zh: 优先重力方案（大埋深时用非开挖）；除非重力方案在要求标高上接不上，不得采用机电（泵站）方案。
items.condition: unless a gravity solution does not connect at the required elevations
items.quote: Optimise for gravity solutions, utilizing non-disruptive and trenchless pipeline installation technologies when large depths are encountered. No electromechanical solutions shall be utilized unless a gravity solution does not connect at the required elevations.

items.rule_zh: 须在管径与附加调蓄容积之间做优化，并做含 NPV 计算的详细比选以论证所选方案。
items.quote: Optimise the size of pipes versus additional storage provided for flow attenuation. Attenuation reduces the peak flow rate and may allow the use of smaller pipes downstream. A detailed appraisal, including NPV calculations, shall be carried out to justify the solution adopted.

items.rule_zh: 仅在确需抽排时设泵站，并优化泵站数量；泵站数量、规模、位置须以含 NPV 的详细比选论证。
items.quote: The number and location of pumping stations shall be balanced against other considerations. A detailed appraisal including Net Present Value (NPV) calculations shall be carried out to justify the number, size and location of pumping stations.

items.rule_zh: 系统须：尽量降低内涝风险；排除积水区；建设与运维成本合理；施工运维无过度健康安全风险；符合环保法规。
items.quote: DEPARTMENT requires storm water and sub-soil drainage systems to be provided which: • Fulfil its requirements for minimizing the risk of flooding • Drain water-logged areas • Are of reasonable cost to construct, operate and maintain

items.rule_zh: 管道最低设计寿命 60 年（用于 NPV 的资产更换计算）。
items.quote: Asset type Minimum Design Life (years) Pipelines 60

items.rule_zh: 钢筋混凝土结构最低设计寿命：按文本抽取顺序对应 50 年（表格排版错位，见含糊项）。
items.quote: Structure (With Reinforcement) Structure (Without Reinforcement) 50 60

items.rule_zh: 无筋结构最低设计寿命：按文本抽取顺序对应 60 年（表格排版错位，见含糊项）。
items.quote: Structure (With Reinforcement) Structure (Without Reinforcement) 50 60

items.rule_zh: 机电设备最低设计寿命 15 年。
items.quote: Mechanical and Electrical Equipment 15

items.rule_zh: 仪表、计算机硬件与传感器最低设计寿命 5 年。
items.quote: Instrumentation, computer hardware & sensors 5

items.rule_zh: 表 2-1 设计寿命用于 NPV 中的资产更换计算；设计报审须含计划维护表与备件清单。
items.quote: A planned maintenance schedule and spare parts list shall form part of the design submission documentation. The design life given in Table 2-1 is to be used in the NPV calculations for asset replacement.

items.rule_zh: 设计中可能需开展环境（如水动力模拟）、海洋、生态、交通、岩土与地下水调查，且耗时可能很长。
items.quote: These may include: • Environmental studies, e.g., hydrodynamic modelling • Marine studies • Ecological studies • Traffic studies • Geotechnical and groundwater investigations

items.rule_zh: 未按主管部门规定取得相应批准前，任何项目不得开工；须遵守 EAD 标准操作程序与技术导则。
items.quote: The Consultant shall note that no project ca n commence prior to securing the appropriate approval in accordance with the regulations determined by the Competent Authority.

items.rule_zh: 排水方案须符合当地、地区法规及阿布扎比签署的国际公约（见附录 A1）。
items.quote: The Consultant’s drainage proposals shall comply with all relevant local and regional legislation and international conventions and protocols to which AbuDhabi is a signatory.

items.rule_zh: 咨询方须确保项目期间符合现行文化遗产许可要求。
items.quote: It is the responsibility of the Consultant to ensure that all curren t requirements relating to cultural heritage permitting are complied with during the project.

items.rule_zh: 各方须遵守 OSHAD 发布的 ADEHSMS 及其实务守则，尤其应考虑第 20 号《设计安全》守则。
items.quote: All parties shall adhere to the Abu Dhabi Environment, Health and Safety Management System (ADEHSMS) published by OSHAD and the associated Codes of Practice

items.rule_zh: 设计须尽量减少施工及资产未来使用中对人员和财产的可预见风险，图纸标注重大施工风险，并为运维手册提供与设计相关的安全信息。
items.quote: minimise foreseeable risks and hazards to people and property directly or indirectly involved or affected by construction work and the future use of the asset

items.rule_zh: 应在项目全周期开展价值管理/价值工程评审（VM1–VM4、VE1–VE2），每次评审后提交报告；如认为不必正式 VM/VE 须取得 DEPARTMENT 同意。
items.quote: VM reviews should be carried out throughout the project life cycle, as set out in the value management plan, and the numbe r required will depend on the project complexity.

items.rule_zh: 须基于与 DEPARTMENT 商定的布置方案做方案比选；最优一般为基于建设费和年费的最低 NPV，同时考虑施工、工期、健康安全风险及环境影响。
items.quote: The optimum balance will normally be given by the lowest NP V based on capital an d annual costs. However, other factors such as construction risk, programme risk, health and safety risk and environmental impact shall also be considered.

items.rule_zh: 各方案建设费须按最新市场单价估算，最好取自 DEPARTMENT 招标价；总体规划阶段可用单价法，详细设计阶段用详细工程量清单；估算方法须事先获批。
items.quote: The capital cost of each option shall be estimated using the latest market rates, preferably obtained from DEPARTMENT tenders.

items.rule_zh: 总体规划阶段用单价法估算即可，精度逐阶段提高至详细设计阶段的详细工程量清单。
items.quote: unit rates will be adequate for the Master Plan stage with increasing accuracy and detail through to the final estimate at detailed design which is to be based on a detailed bill of quantities.

items.rule_zh: 运维费须征询 DEPARTMENT 估算，包括人工、车辆机械、电力、配件耗材、化学品、运维管理；咨询方编制日/周/月/年运维工程量表，由 DEPARTMENT 填单价。
items.quote: The operating and maintenance costs of each option shall be estimated taking advice from DEPARTMENT as the long-term owner. Costs will include: • Labour • Vehicles and plant • Power • Parts and consumables • Chemicals • O&M management

items.rule_zh: NPV 自开工时起算，所有费用按现行价格基准；评估期由 DEPARTMENT 提供，折现率由咨询方与 DEPARTMENT 协调确定，可能要求高低折现率敏感性分析。
items.quote: NPV costs shall be calculated from the time of construction commencement and all costs are to be at the current price base.

items.rule_zh: 财务评估期由 DEPARTMENT 提供，折现率由咨询方与 DEPARTMENT 协调决定；DEPARTMENT 可要求做高低折现率敏感性检查。
items.quote: DEPARTMENT will provide the evaluation period to be used in the financial appraisal, and the Consultant will decide on the discount rate in coordination with DEPARTMENT. A sensitivity check with higher and lower discount rates may also be requested by DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 采用第 2 卷标准图时不得改动（注明可改处除外）；典型图仅供参考，可按项目调整。
items.quote: Standard drawings are included in Volume 2: Standard Drawings. Where th ese are used, they shall not be altered except where indicated.

items.rule_zh: 所有材料须符合第 4 卷标准规范并经 DEPARTMENT 材料科批准。
items.quote: All materials shall comply with the Volume 4: Standard Specifications and shall be approved by the Materials Section of DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 如 DEPARTMENT 要求，须建立并提交二维模型以反映实际内涝。
items.quote: Prepare 2D model and submit if requested by the DEPARTMENT to realize actual floods

items.rule_zh: 汇水面积 <80 ha 和/或 tc <30 min 且无显著调蓄/回水时用推理公式法；>80 ha 和/或 tc >30 min 推荐 SCS 法（SCS 可用于任意规模）。
items.condition: catchment < 80 ha and/or tc < 30 min -> Rational; > 80 ha and/or tc > 30 min -> SCS
items.quote: For catchment areas < 80 ha and / or tc < 30 mins and no significant retention and / or back water effects, the rational method will be used.

items.rule_zh: 雨水管网服务区一般设计标准为 5 年一遇。
items.condition: all areas served by storm water networks (except listed exceptions)
items.quote: 1 in 5 Years Storm This is the design standard for all areas served by storm water networks, with the exceptions highlighted in the rows below.

items.rule_zh: 主干道、宫殿、渗井及经批准的其他重要区域按 10 年一遇。
items.condition: Major roads, palaces, soakaways and other critical areas, as approved by DEPARTMENT
items.quote: 1 in 10 Years Storm Major roads, palaces, soakaways and other critical areas, as approved by DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 次要道路涵洞（校核 50 年）；无出口且漫顶会淹房屋的塘（lagoon）及渗井按 25 年一遇；机场、港口 25 年（校核 50 年）。
items.condition: lagoons & soakaways that do not have an outlet and where overtopping may lead to flooding of properties
items.quote: 1 in 25 Years Storm Culverts on minor roads (and check for 1 in 50 years storm); lagoons & soakaways that do not have an outlet and where overtopping may lead to flooding of properties*

items.rule_zh: 下穿通道和地下停车场坡道、主干道涵洞按 50 年一遇（主干道涵洞校核 100 年）。
items.condition: Underpasses and underground car parks (Ramps); Culverts on major roads (check 1 in 100)
items.quote: 1 in 50 Year Storm Underpasses and underground car parks (Ramps); Culverts on major roads (and check for 1 in 100 years storm)

items.rule_zh: 有出口或有不影响房屋/道路使用者的入海漫流通道的塘，按表 3-2 中高一级标准确定容积（如 5 年一遇汇水区的塘按 10 年一遇设计，之前不得溢流）。
items.condition: lagoons with an outlet or overland flow track to sea not disrupting properties or road users
items.quote: a lagoon serving an area which is generally a 1 in 5-year catchment type shall be sized for a 1 in 10-year storm before overflow occurs

items.rule_zh: 推理公式法设计暴雨历时 = M×Tc；优先级 1（Major Roads; expressways; arterials; underpasses; Airports; Seaports; road crossings and culverts; underground car parks (Ramps)）M = 1。仅适用于推理公式法；SCS 法只乘在初始汇流时间上。
items.condition: Major Roads; expressways; arterials; underpasses; Airports; Seaports; road crossings and culverts; underground car parks (Ramps); Rational Method only
items.quote: 1 Major Roads; expressways; arterials; underpasses; Airports; Seaports; road crossings and culverts; underground car parks (Ramps) Tc

items.rule_zh: 推理公式法设计暴雨历时 = M×Tc；优先级 2（High density sectors (>= 50% impermeable area)）M = 2。仅适用于推理公式法；SCS 法只乘在初始汇流时间上。
items.condition: High density sectors (>= 50% impermeable area); Rational Method only
items.quote: 2 High density sectors (≥ 50% impermeable area) 2 x Tc

items.rule_zh: 推理公式法设计暴雨历时 = M×Tc；优先级 3（Low density sectors (<= 50% impermeable area)）M = 3。仅适用于推理公式法；SCS 法只乘在初始汇流时间上。
items.condition: Low density sectors (<= 50% impermeable area); Rational Method only
items.quote: 3 Low density sectors (≤ 50% impermeable area) 3 x Tc

items.rule_zh: 推理公式法设计暴雨历时 = M×Tc；优先级 4（Industrial sectors (if >50% impervious treat as low density)）M = 5。仅适用于推理公式法；SCS 法只乘在初始汇流时间上。
items.condition: Industrial sectors (if >50% impervious treat as low density); Rational Method only
items.quote: 4 Industrial sectors* 5 x Tc

items.rule_zh: 推理公式法设计暴雨历时 = M×Tc；优先级 5（Open areas, parks and areas of infrequent use and not subject to building flooding）M = 12。仅适用于推理公式法；SCS 法只乘在初始汇流时间上。
items.condition: Open areas, parks and areas of infrequent use and not subject to building flooding; Rational Method only
items.quote: 5 Open areas, parks and areas of infrequent use and not subject to building flooding 12 x Tc

items.rule_zh: 阿布扎比未开发区坡面流 Manning n 推荐 0.020–0.035。
items.quote: It is recommended that an appropriate ‘n’ value to use for undeveloped areas of Abu Dhabi lies between 0.020 and  0.035.

items.rule_zh: 不透水汇水区入流时间最小取 10 分钟。
items.quote: A minimum value of 10 minutes should be used for impervious catchments.

items.rule_zh: 研究区分两区：东北山区为 Zone A，其余平坦区为 Zone B，分界约在 200 m 等高线；各项目须与 DEPARTMENT 确认用哪一区。
items.quote: The dividing line between the two zones is around the contour line equal to 200 m above mean sea level.

items.rule_zh: 估算满管流速（汇流时间计算）时 Manning n 取 0.015。
items.condition: estimating pipe full velocity for time of concentration
items.quote: Estimate the pipe full velocity (V f) using Manning’s equation and a Manning’s n value of 0.015

items.rule_zh: Zone A（东北山区）IDF/DDF 见表 3-4、3-5（RD-A 位于平坦区，未逐行抄）。
items.quote: Table 3-4 - Recommended IDF and DDF tables for use in Zone A

Zone B IDF 公式 i = α(M·t)^-β（t 为小时）：50 年一遇 α = 40.284，β = 0.777。

Zone B IDF 公式 i = α(M·t)^-β（t 为小时）：15 年一遇 α = 22.327，β = 0.695。
Zone B IDF 公式 i = α(M·t)^-β（t 为小时）：10 年一遇 α = 21.183，β = 0.723。
Zone B IDF 公式 i = α(M·t)^-β（t 为小时）：5 年一遇 α = 18.685，β = 0.725。

items.quote: Confirm with DEPARTMENT as to which zone to use based on each project requirements. Some projects may also need individual analysis or equivalent factors to be used with the IDF data.

items.rule_zh: 推理公式法仅用于 <80 ha 或 tc <30 min 的汇水区；不太适合模拟外来入流、回水及经塘（lagoon）和渗井的调蓄演算，否则可能导致不经济设计。
items.quote: Rational Method is not much suitable to simulate effect of external incoming flows, backwater, and routing through lagoons and soakaways, for this may result in uneconomical designs.

items.rule_zh: 城区径流系数推荐值：> 70% irrigated grass & plantings = 0.15（须按项目土地利用确认并与 DEPARTMENT 商定）。
items.quote: > 70% irrigated grass & plantings 0.15

items.rule_zh: 城区径流系数推荐值：Poor ground cover = 0.2（须按项目土地利用确认并与 DEPARTMENT 商定）。
items.quote: Poor ground cover 0.20

items.rule_zh: 城区径流系数推荐值：Asphaltic = 0.9（须按项目土地利用确认并与 DEPARTMENT 商定）。
items.quote: Asphaltic 0.90

items.rule_zh: 城区径流系数推荐值：Concrete = 0.9（须按项目土地利用确认并与 DEPARTMENT 商定）。
items.quote: Concrete 0.90

items.rule_zh: 城区径流系数推荐值：Interlocking = 0.78（须按项目土地利用确认并与 DEPARTMENT 商定）。
items.quote: Interlocking 0.78

items.rule_zh: 城区径流系数推荐值：Roofs = 0.85（须按项目土地利用确认并与 DEPARTMENT 商定）。
items.quote: Roofs 0.85

items.rule_zh: 城区径流系数推荐值：Walled plot; not connected to network = 0.2（须按项目土地利用确认并与 DEPARTMENT 商定）。
items.condition: Walled plot; not connected to network
items.quote: Walled plot; not connected to network 0.20

items.rule_zh: 径流系数须按具体项目土地利用/覆盖确认，并逐项目与 DEPARTMENT 商定。
items.quote: Consultants are required to confirm above coefficients based on land use / land cove in any specific project. Coefficient values need to be agreed with DEPARTMENT for each project.

items.rule_zh: 推理公式：Q = 2.77×10^-3·C·i·A（Q m3/s，i mm/h，A ha）。
items.quote: To calculate peak flow using the rational method, the following equation should be used: CiAQ 31077.2 −=

items.rule_zh: 无土壤资料时按 B 类水文土壤组；水力模型推荐采用 SCS II 型累积雨型（除非 DEPARTMENT 另有规定）。
items.quote: If no information on soils exists, then it should be assumed to be Group B.

items.rule_zh: 水力模型推荐使用 SCS II 型累积雨型曲线，除非 DEPARTMENT 另行规定。
items.quote: Recommended type of curve to be used for hydraulic modelling should be SCS Type II Cumulative type curve, unless otherwise specified by DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 城区 CN 值见表 3-11（AMC II）。文本抽取中行列错位：如『paved with curbs and storm sewers 98 98 98 98』，草地 39/61/74/80 与 49/69/79/84、68/79/86/89 对应关系需核对原 PDF。
items.quote: Streets and roads: paved with curbs and storm sewers 98 98 98 98 gravel 76 85 89 91 dirt 72 82 87 89 paved with open ditches 83 89 92 93

items.rule_zh: 水力模型中滞时 TL = 0.6 Tc，退水时间 = 1.67×Tp，用默认 SCS 峰值系数，无基流；雨型用过程线。
items.quote: In hydraulic modelling software, the lag time TL should be set at 0.6 Tc, the recession time to 1.67 x Tp and the default SCS peak rate factor should be used, with no base flow.

items.rule_zh: 系统含显著容积的调蓄池、需考虑管网调蓄、潮汐回水、限流措施、外来入流或排入超载管网时，须用水力模型。
items.condition: retention/detention tanks with significant volumes, tidal backwater, flow restriction, external inflows, surcharged receiving system
items.quote: Where the system contains the following, hydraulic modelling is to be used: • Retention / detention tanks with significant volumes are used • Retention in the network needs to be considered • Backwater condition (e.g. from tide cycle) needs to be considered

items.rule_zh: 无论用何方法，总径流量都必须与手算结果核对。
items.quote: Whichever method is used, the total runoff must be checked against a manual calculation to verify the magnitude of the runoff is correct.

items.rule_zh: 水力模型须兼容 CIVILSTORM（ADM），或 CIVILSTORM/SewerGEMS、INFOWORKS（AACM），或提交 shapefile；如要求须并入现有模型。
items.quote: The hydraulic model shall be compatible with CIVILSTORM (for ADM); and CIVILSTORM / SewerGEMS, and INFOWORKS (for AACM) , or shape file exports are to be submitted to DEPARTMENT

items.rule_zh: 混合汇水区应对可能主导响应的子区单独分析；子区流量大于整体估算时取子区值。
items.condition: catchments with very different hydrological characteristics
items.quote: Where the flow from this sub catchment is greater than the flow predicted from the catchment when considered as a whole, the higher value from the sub-catchment should be used.

items.rule_zh: 调蓄塘/地下调蓄池容积计算的设计标准与流量计算相同（3.2.1），不应用汇流时间倍数。
items.condition: flood volume calculations for retention basins, lagoons, tanks
items.quote: The design standard should be  as for flow calculations (see S ection 3.2.1); no time of concentration multipliers should be applied.

items.rule_zh: 推理公式法容积估算只用于初步定容，且仅限推理公式适用的汇水区。
items.condition: initial sizing; catchments where rational method valid
items.quote: The Rational Method for flood volumes  should be used only for initial sizing of retention basins etc, for catchments where the rational method is valid for estimation of peak flows.

items.rule_zh: 调蓄容积 = 入流过程线高于下游最大设计出流的面积；须对一系列暴雨历时重复计算，取最大值。
items.quote: The calculation should be repeated for a range of storm durations and the maximum volume used as the retention volume.

items.rule_zh: 详细设计时，调蓄设施及出流控制堰等应在模型中表达，对设计重现期的一系列历时计算峰值出流和调蓄量，验证不超容且出流低于允许最大值。
items.quote: Each potential set of design characteristics (retention volume, outflow weir design etc.) should be tested to verify that the storage volume is not exceeded and that the outflow from the storage structure is below the acceptable maximum.

items.rule_zh: 塘服务的区域若未接入有最终排海口的雨水管网（无下游管网），最小调蓄容积为整条过程线下的全部面积（全量径流）。
items.condition: areas not connected to a stormwater network with a final outfall to sea
items.quote: When designing a pond or lagoon for areas that are not connected to a stormwater network with a final outfall to sea (no downstream network), the minimum retention volume of the pond or lagoon will be represented by the entire area under the graph.

items.rule_zh: 新开发区雨水系统须排入现有雨水系统、蒸发塘或直接排海。
items.quote: Storm water drainage systems in new development areas shall discharge to the existing storm water drainage system, to evaporation lagoons or direct to the sea.

items.rule_zh: 未受污染雨水只能接入雨水系统，生活污水只能接入污水系统。
items.quote: Uncontaminated rainfall run -off must only connect to the storm water system, and domestic sewage flow must only connect to the foul sewer system.

items.rule_zh: 新系统设计须考虑受纳管网或排出口的水力约束；DEPARTMENT 给出允许接入点、现状系统最高水位和最大允许排放流量。
items.quote: DEPARTMENT will identify the constraints on the design of new connections to its storm water system. These will take the form of permitted points of connection, the maximum water levels in the existing system and the maximum permitted discharge rates from the new development.

items.rule_zh: ≤80 ha 和/或 tc ≤30 min 的管网须用推理公式法设计；更大汇水区或 tc >30 min 须用 SCS 法。
items.condition: <= 80 ha and/or tc <= 30 min: Rational; larger or tc > 30 min: SCS
items.quote: For larger catchments or where the ‘time of concentration’ is greater than 30 minutes the SCS method shall be used, again supported by proprietary network design software as appropriate.

items.rule_zh: 初步及详细设计报告（草稿与终稿）须同时提交模型，并按第 8 节导出 DBF/SHP。
items.quote: Models must be submitted with the draft and final preliminary and detailed design reports.

items.rule_zh: 若重力坡度达不到 4.3.2 的最小自清流速，须加陡坡度并在必要处设中途泵站，且须经 DEPARTMENT 批准。
items.condition: gravity gradients do not give minimum cleansing velocities
items.quote: If the pipe gradients available for gravity flow do not give the required minimum cleansing velocities given in Section 4.3.2 then they shall be steepened and intermediate pumping stat ions introduced where necessary, and will be subject to DEPARTMENT approval.

items.rule_zh: 雨水管最小管径推荐 300 mm。
items.quote: A minimum pipe diameter of 300mm is recommended for surface water pipes.

items.rule_zh: 管线敷设走廊（service reservation）由 DPM 分配、DEPARTMENT 最终批准，应尽早获取；现有及规划管线位置向各管线单位获取；走廊宽度须符合 DPM《公用设施走廊设计手册》（UCDM）。
items.quote: Service reservation widths shall comply with the current requirements of the DPM’s Utility Corridor Design Manual (UCDM).

items.rule_zh: 现状及规划管线位置须向相应公用事业单位获取。
items.quote: The location of existing and planned utilities shall be obtained from the relevant utility provider.

items.rule_zh: 可能需要测试多种暴雨类型以得到最不利工况；不鼓励大量不受控外排流量，必要时须估算并评估其影响。
items.quote: Large uncontrolled outgoing external flows are discouraged; these however ma y need to be estimated and their impact be evaluated.

items.rule_zh: 无出口且漫顶可能淹没房屋的塘（滞洪塘）须按容纳 25 年一遇暴雨全部径流设计。
items.condition: lagoons without outlet where overtopping may flood properties
items.quote: Lagoons (detention ponds) that do not have an outlet and where overtopping may lead to flooding of properties shall be designed to hold the run-off from a 1 in 25-year storm.

items.rule_zh: 有出口或有不影响房屋/道路使用者的入海漫流通道的塘，按表 3-2 中高一级重现期定容（如 5 年一遇区的塘按 10 年一遇，溢流前须能容纳）。
items.condition: lagoons with outlet or overland flow track to sea
items.quote: Lagoons that have an outlet or overland flow track to sea that does not cause disruption to properties or road users, the lagoon is to be sized for the next higher event in Table 3-2

items.rule_zh: 除经 DEPARTMENT 同意并在相应设计暴雨/重现期下完成校核外，不允许地面积水。
items.quote: No surface flooding will b e allowed unless agreed with DEPARTMENT, along with the necessary checks at the appropriate design storms and return periods.
