items.rule_zh: 管道与任何现状管线的平面净距不小于 500 mm，并须符合 DEPARTMENT 管线走廊尺寸。
items.condition: plan clearance to any existing utility
items.quote: Pipelines shall be positioned to give a minimum clear gap of 500mm in plan to any existing utility and shall comply with DEPARTMENT’s service corridor dimensions.

items.rule_zh: 须设置流量调蓄以削减峰值、使设计更经济并满足现状管网水力约束。
items.quote: Flow attenuation shall be provided to lower peak flow rate to produce more economic designs and to meet hydraulic constraints in the existing networks.

items.rule_zh: 调蓄也可用于降低总成本（如使泵站变小）；任何情况下都须做 NPV 计算证明其经济性。
items.quote: An example might be when attenuation results in a smaller pumpin g station when pumping is required. In all cases, Net Present Value (NPV) calculations shall be carried out to show that such a proposal would be cost-effective.

items.rule_zh: 调蓄形式限于：A 在线调蓄（塘或超大管，下游设流量控制装置）；B 离线调蓄（混凝土箱涵；B.1 小出口控制+高位溢流回主管；B.2 土工格室模块）；C 塘或混凝土箱（滞洪塘），在标高和位置允许时采用。
value: on-line storage (ponds/oversized pipes) with flow control
items.quote: Attenuation shall be provided by either: A. on-line storages (e.g., ponds or oversized pipes) with a flow control device at their downstream end to limit the pass-forward flow and to mobilise the storage, B. off-line storages (e.g., concrete box)

items.rule_zh: 离线调蓄（小出口控制、高位溢流回主管）应设冲洗系统，如翻斗或高压射流。
items.quote: B.1 off-line storages with a small outlet flow control device and high-level overflow back to the main storm water line.  A flushing system should be provided such as tipping buckets or high-pressure jetting.

items.rule_zh: 在线调蓄为首选调蓄方式，因其维护要求较低。
items.quote: Online storage is the preferred method of attenuation as it reduces the maintenance requirements.

items.rule_zh: 塘或混凝土箱（滞洪塘）仅在标高和位置允许时采用；推荐与前池或其他预处理设施配合以降低运维费用。
items.quote: C. Lagoon or concrete boxes (detention pond) where levels and location permit. Forebay or other pre-treatment devices are recommended to be used with ponds to economise O&M costs.

items.rule_zh: 开敞塘（open lagoon）不得设在已开发区域内或其附近。
items.quote: Open lagoons shall not be permitted within or close to developed areas.

items.rule_zh: 在开发商用地范围外铺管、建塘及其他构筑物，须取得 DEPARTMENT 及受影响土地业主许可。
items.quote: Permission to lay pipes and construct lagoons and other structures outside the developer’s area shall be obtained from DEPARTMENT and affected landowners.

items.rule_zh: 塘与离线调蓄设施容积须比所需调蓄容积大 5%，以计入积沙。
items.quote: Lagoons and off -line storages shall be sized to have a volume 5% larger than the required attenuation volume, to account for sedimentation of sand within the structure.

items.rule_zh: 离线调蓄设施（含地下池）容积须比所需调蓄容积大 5%，以计入积沙。
items.quote: Lagoons and off -line storages shall be sized to have a volume 5% larger than the required attenuation volume, to account for sedimentation of sand within the structure.

items.rule_zh: 也可通过允许部分选定地面积水（特别是较大暴雨时）实现调蓄，但须遵守 4.1.3（须经 DEPARTMENT 同意）。
items.quote: It may also be possible to provide flow attenuation by allowing some selected surface flooding, particularly during more severe storms, although the requirements in Section 4.1.3 shall be observed.

items.rule_zh: 在可行且经济时，调蓄措施须尽量靠近来水源头。
items.quote: Where practical and cost-effective, flow attenuation measures shall be provided as close as possible to the source of flow.

items.rule_zh: 塘可作为临时滞洪设施（如设在游憩区或游乐场），塑形并景观化以与周边融为一体。
items.quote: Lagoons may be provided as a means of temporary flood storage (such as in recreation or playground areas), shaped and landscaped to be integrated with the surroundings .

items.rule_zh: 塘须防渗（water-tight），容积按 4.1.2 确定。
items.quote: They shall be water -tight and designed to hold the volume derived in accordance with Section 4.1.2.

items.rule_zh: 塘的出流可重力回流或泵送回雨水管网。
value: pumping back to the storm water network
items.quote: The outflow may be by gravity return or pumping back to the storm water network.

items.rule_zh: 塘须在暴雨结束后立即自动开始排空。
items.quote: Lagoons shall start to empty automatically immediately after the storm event.

items.rule_zh: 土工格室系统组件须包括（不限于）格室模块、连接件、集配管、出流控制装置、土工布、土工膜及沉砂井/除砂分离器。
items.quote: The system main components shall include but not limited to; geo -cellular blocks, connectors, manifold, outlet flow control devices, geo-textiles, geo-membranes and silt trap or sediment removal separator.

items.rule_zh: 土工格室系统须设清淤口、排空设施及紧急逃生；设计参照 CIRIA C737。
items.quote: Cleanouts and emptying arrangement as well as emergency escape to be provided. Refer to CIRIA C737 for further design guidance.

items.rule_zh: 土工格室容积：估算场地总径流量，按手册确定排至排出口的允许流量，再据场地条件确定地下储存量及所需模块数。
items.quote: The anticipated total run-off volume from the site is estimated, and the allowable discharge rate from the site to an appropriate outfall is determined according to this manual.

items.rule_zh: 带土工膜的储存应用，所有接口推荐用法兰接头，并用胶粘剂或双面胶保证水密。
items.quote: It is recommended that all connections into storage applications (using a geo-membrane) are made using a flange adaptor.

items.rule_zh: 连接模块与排水系统的管道应有足够能力通过设计流量；管道按 BS EN 1401-1:2009。
items.quote: The system designer should ensure the pipework connecting the units to the drainage system has sufficient capacity to cope with the design flow.

items.rule_zh: 出流管管底应与最低一层模块底齐平以便排空；计算水头取出流装置管底线处。
items.quote: The invert level of the outflow pipe should be flush with the bottom of the lowest unit to allow the system to drain.

items.rule_zh: 重力管设计参数不得偏离，除非获 DEPARTMENT 同意。
items.quote: The required system design parameters are given below. Deviation from these is not permitted without the agreement of DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 管道水力计算推荐 Colebrook-White 公式（35°C 水运动黏度 0.727×10^-6 m2/s），也可用 Manning 公式。
items.quote: The recommended hydraulic design formula for pipes is t he ‘Colebrook-White’ formula, as this gives the greatest accuracy.
Water = 0.727 x 10 -6 m2 s-1 (at 35oC)

items.rule_zh: uPVC Pipes：Colebrook-White k = 0.3（良好）/0.6（一般）/1.5（较差）mm；Manning n = 0.011。
GRP Pipes：Colebrook-White k = 0.3（良好）/0.6（一般）/1.5（较差）mm；Manning n = 0.012。
HDPE Pipes (plain and corrugated)：Colebrook-White k = 0.3（良好）/0.6（一般）/1.5（较差）mm；Manning n = 0.012。
items.quote: HDPE Pipes (plain and corrugated) 0.3 0.6 1.5 0.012

items.rule_zh: Lined Concrete Pipes：Colebrook-White k = 0.3（良好）/0.6（一般）/1.5（较差）mm；Manning n = 0.011。
items.quote: Lined Concrete Pipes 0.3 0.6 1.5 0.011

items.rule_zh: Un-lined Concrete Pipes：Colebrook-White k = 0.3（良好）/0.6（一般）/1.5（较差）mm；Manning n = 0.013。（For Al Ain region only）
items.quote: Un-lined Concrete Pipes* *0.3 *0.6 *1.5 *0.013 ... *For Al Ain region only

items.rule_zh: 鼓励管道超载运行，前提是 5 年一遇暴雨下水位距检查井盖留有 0.3 m 净空。
items.quote: Surcharge conditions of the flow are encouraged for all pipe systems, where applicable, if a clearance of 0.3 m (for the 1 in 5 – year storm event) is provided from manhole covers.

items.rule_zh: 重力雨水管峰值流量时最小流速须大于 0.75 m/s（自清）；仅管网最上游起始段经与 DEPARTMENT 讨论可接受更低流速。
items.condition: at peak flow; lower only at early upstream after discussion with DEPARTMENT
items.quote: To provide a self -cleansing regime within gravity storm waterpipes, the minimum velocity shall be above 0.75 m/s at peak flow.

items.rule_zh: 最大流速不得超过 2.5 m/s。
items.quote: The maximum flow velocity shall not exceed 2.5m/sto minimiseenergy dissipation problems.

items.rule_zh: 流速过高时一般不推荐用跌水井消能，应寻求专家意见；尽量避免临界流和急弯。
items.quote: Where system flows would result in higher velocities then the use of backdrop manholes for energy dissipation is generally not recommended.  Specialist advice should be obtained if this occurs.

items.rule_zh: 分期开发的项目须计算每期末流速，可能需加陡坡度以保证早期小流量时的流速（须经 DEPARTMENT 同意）。
items.quote: Where a scheme is to be developed in phases over several years, calculations shall be carried out to show the flow velocities at the end of each phase.

items.rule_zh: 在坡度小、流速高、急弯、跌落大等情况下，设计须计入检查井、构筑物及管道的局部水头损失。
items.condition: minimal slopes, high velocities, acute bends, large manhole drops
items.quote: In some case s (such as when profile slopes are minimal , and velocities are high, bends are acute, Mhdrops are large, etc), design calculations need to allow for the additional head losses that will occur in manholes, chambers and pipes.

items.rule_zh: 可接受的重力管材：衬里混凝土管/现浇衬里混凝土箱涵（BS5911、BS EN1916）、GRP（BS 5480）、uPVC（BS EN 1452）、结构壁/波纹 HDPE（ISO 4427）；无衬里混凝土管仅限艾因市。其他管材须经批准。
value: lined concrete pipe / in-situ lined concrete culvert
items.quote: The following gravity pipes materials are acceptable to DEPARTMENT:

items.rule_zh: GRP 管最小刚度 5,000 N/m2（原文单位）。
items.quote: Minimum stiffness for GRP pipes is 5,000 N/m2.

items.rule_zh: （艾因市 uPVC 行）道路下雨水管须符合 DIN 8061/8062 或 ISO 4422（2.5）。
items.condition: stormwater pipe under the road (Al Ain uPVC row)
items.quote: Any stormwater pipe under the road shall comply with DIN 8061/8062 or ISO 4422 (2.5)

items.rule_zh: 结构壁/波纹 HDPE 管在大管径及建造地下调蓄池时具成本优势。
items.quote: Structured Wall / Corrugated HDPE Pipes (SWPP) ISO 4427 Cost-effective in larger sizes and for constructing underground storage tanks.

items.rule_zh: 衬里混凝土管的优点是可做成矩形箱涵形式。
items.quote: BS5911, BS EN1916 Has the benefit of being available in rectangular culvert form

items.rule_zh: 在满足挠曲和椭圆度要求前提下，管材选择取决于垫层及施工费用和规格可得性；其他管材须经批准，优先 ADQCC 认证材料。
items.quote: the choice will be determined by bedding and construction cost and size availability. Other pipe materials may be c onsidered, subject to approval of DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 无附加保护的管道最小覆土 1200 mm
items.quote: The minimum cover to pipes without additional protection shall be 1200mm.

items.rule_zh: 管网起端覆土达不到 1200 mm 时须加保护（混凝土包封或保护板）
items.condition: where not cost-effective to start with 1200mm cover
items.quote: Where it is not cost -effective to have the head of the system starting with 1200mm cover then additional protect ion shall be provided to the pipes. Additional protection will usually take the form of concrete bed and surround or protection slabs.

items.rule_zh: 确定覆土时须考虑施工临时状态、场地整平及将来地面标高变化
items.quote: the Consultant shall consider if and by how much existing ground levels and imposed surface loads may change as a result of: a) temporary conditions during construction b) re-profiling of the ground as part of the site development c) possible future changes to ground levels

items.rule_zh: 沟槽深度大于 10 m、地质困难或需穿越障碍时须考虑非开挖
items.condition: trench depth > 10m or difficult ground or obstacle
items.quote: Where the trench depth is greater than 10m or where difficult ground conditions exist or there is an obstacle to be passed, the Consultant shall consider whether a trenchless construction technique would be safer than open cut trenching.

items.rule_zh: 管道抗浮安全系数不小于 1.1，不足时加混凝土压重
items.quote: The Consultant shall carry out calculations to demonstrate that there is a Factor of Safety of at least 1.1 against pipe flotation under all practical circumstances.

items.rule_zh: 地面雨水口须设沉砂斗
items.quote: Surface water collection inlets shall include a sump to trap sand as shown on the Standard Drawings.

items.rule_zh: 每个雨水口连接管（rider pipe）最长 50 m，末端接截污井（catch basin）
items.quote: Each inlet shall be connected to a rider pipe of maximum length 50m which at its end shall connect to a catch basin.

items.rule_zh: 截污井至检查井的连接管尽量短；两条以上支管交汇处和检查井上游须设截污井
items.quote: Each catch basin shall connect to a manhole by as short a pipe as possible. Catch basins shall be specified at junctions of two or more lateral pipes, and at the upstream of manholes.

items.rule_zh: 雨水口间距按附录 A3 计算，一般 20–50 m，以水面漫流宽度计算确认
items.condition: as confirmed by water spread calculations
items.quote: Recommended spacing between inlets should be calculated as stated in Appendix A3, inlets/ gullies can generally be spaced between 20-50m intervals, as confirmed by the water spread calculations.

items.rule_zh: 城区道路凹点按单个雨水口设计，但须建双雨水口以防堵塞
items.condition: pronounced low spots in a sagging road profile in urban areas
items.quote: At the pronounced low spots in a sagging road profile in urban areas, the system is to be designed for a single inlet; however, a double inlet is to be constructed to ensure that the system will operate in the event of the blockage of an inlet.

items.rule_zh: 雨水口和截污井只用于管径不超过 500 mm 的管线
items.quote: Inlets and catch basins shall be used where pipeline sizes are up to 500mm diameter.

items.rule_zh: 雨水口和截污井的管底埋深不超过 2.8 m
items.quote: Depth to invert of inlets and catch basins shall not exceed 2.8m.

items.rule_zh: 出水管径≤300 mm、管底深 D≤2.0 m：雨水口内尺寸 600×600 mm，截污井内尺寸 600×1600 mm
items.condition: outlet pipe diameter up to 300 mm

items.rule_zh: 出水管径≤500 mm、管底深 2.0<D≤2.8 m：雨水口内尺寸 1000×1000 mm，截污井内尺寸 1000×1600 mm
items.condition: outlet pipe diameter up to 500 mm

items.rule_zh: 风沙少等特殊情况，雨水口可不经截污井直接接检查井
items.condition: areas subject to minimal or no sand storms
items.quote: On special cases (such as areas subject to minimal or no sand storms), and depending on the project limitations, inlets could be arranged to discharge directly to the storm water manhole structure without catch basin

items.rule_zh: 场地布置须防止漫流直接进入雨水口，除非设中间沉淀设施（如浅洼地）
items.quote: The design and layout of the development shall incorporate features which prevent overland flow draining to inlets unless an intermediate settlement facility is provided, for example a shallow depression in the finished ground level.

items.rule_zh: 施工期须设施防止开挖和堆料的砂土进入雨水管网
items.quote: Facilities shall be provided which minimise or prevent such material reaching the storm water network.

items.rule_zh: 检查井通常设在每处转向或变坡、每条支线起端、每个管道交汇处及变管径处（管顶平接）
items.quote: Manholes shall normally be built at: • every change of alignment or gradient • the head of each branch of the network • every pipe junction • wherever there is a change of pipe size, the connection shall be ‘soffit to soffit’.

items.rule_zh: 管径≤300 mm（穿孔管）检查井间距不超过 100 m
items.quote: intervals not exceeding 100m for pipes ≤ 300mm diameter (perforated lines)

items.rule_zh: 管径 300–600 mm 检查井间距不超过 120 m
items.quote: intervals not exceeding 120m for pipes 300mm to 600mm diameter.

items.rule_zh: 管径 700 和 800 mm 检查井间距不超过 160 m
items.quote: intervals not exceeding 160m for pipes 700mm & 800mm diameter

items.rule_zh: 管径 900–1100 mm 检查井间距不超过 200 m
items.quote: intervals not exceeding 200m for pipes from900mm  to 1100mm diameter

items.rule_zh: 管径≥1200 mm 检查井间距可达 300 m，须经 DEPARTMENT 批准
items.condition: pipe diameters >= 1200mm, subject to DEPARTMENT approval
items.quote: for pipe diameters ≥ 1200mm interval may reach 300m, subject to DEPARTMENT approval

items.rule_zh: 上述间距仅为指示值，须按设计计算和现场调查确定
items.quote: The above mentioned spacing values are based on typical installation conditions and shall only be taken as indicative. The Consultant shall undertake design calculations and site investigation to determine manholes spaces to suit the site conditions / layout.

items.rule_zh: 检查井位置须便于安全检修并尽量减少对公众和业主的干扰
items.quote: Manholes shall be located to provide safe access for maintenance but also to minim ise disruption to the general public and property owners during maintenance.

items.rule_zh: 检查井定位应考虑施工开挖范围及其对相邻管线的影响
items.quote: The positioning of manholes should consider the size of the excavation required to construct the chamber and the impact this may have on adjacent utilities.

items.rule_zh: 所有检查井须设爬梯；井盖尺寸须满足维护设备进出、佩戴呼吸器人员进入和担架救人；需定期维护的设施（如闸门）须能从地面直接进入
items.quote: All manholes shall be provided with access ladders. • Manhole covers shall be sized to allow for access for maintenance equipment, man-entry with breathing equipment and removal of a casualty by stretcher.

items.rule_zh: 铺装区井盖标高 = 最终铺装面标高
items.quote: Paved areas final paved level.

items.rule_zh: 绿化区井盖标高 = 最终地面 +0.1 m
items.quote: Landscaped areas final ground level +0.1m

items.rule_zh: 空旷未铺装区井盖标高 = 最终地面 +0.25 m
items.quote: Open, unpaved areas final ground level +0.25m.

items.rule_zh: 特殊情况经 DEPARTMENT 同意可用下沉井盖，须精确定位并标在竣工图上
items.quote: In exceptional cases and where agreed with DEPARTMENT the manhole may have a recessed cover, in which case the location shall be precisely identified in relation to adjoining permanent features and shown on the record drawings.

items.rule_zh: 非开挖工作井间距须与 DEPARTMENT 商定
items.quote: The spacing of shafts for trenchless construction shall be as agreed with DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 管径≥900 mm 的管道须在检查井上游开口处装不锈钢安全链
items.quote: Pipes of 900mm diameter or greater shall be fitted with stainless steel safety chains at the manhole upstream openings.

items.rule_zh: 井盖提升重量超过 25 kg 时须配便携式起吊装置
items.quote: Where covers with a lift weight greater than 25kg are used then portable lifting mechanism for ease of lifting and no damages to the coating of covers shall be used.

items.rule_zh: 位于公共区域或井深大于 2 m 的井盖须可上锁
items.condition: covers in public areas or manhole/chamber depth > 2m
items.quote: Where covers are in public areas or where the depth of the manhole or chamber is greater than 2m, provision shall be included for locking the covers.

items.rule_zh: 停车场和加油站前场须设隔油池；隔油池须便于清掏、设在自然通风良好处、不得设于封闭空间
items.condition: car parks and oil station forecourts
items.quote: For car parks and oil station forecourts the risk arises from run-off being contaminated with hydrocarbons and oil interceptors shall be provided. Interceptors shall be located to give good access for the removal of contaminated material.

items.rule_zh: 隔油池按最大污染流量的 2 倍设计；轻质液体停留时间≥3 min（≤20 l/s），每增加 10 l/s 加 1 min；宽长比 1:1.8
items.quote: Size of separator shall be based on double the maximum contaminated water flow. • For light liquids the retention time shall be a minimum of 3 minutes up to a design flow of 20 l/s. For higher flows an additional minute shall be added per 10 l/s increase. • The width to length ratio shall be 1:1.8

items.rule_zh: 附近需设泵站时，泵站须位于隔油池下游
items.condition: where a pumping station is required in the vicinity of an interceptor
items.quote: Where a pumping station is required in the vicinity it shall be located downstream of an interceptor.

items.rule_zh: 有泵送排放或排向公共休闲区、塘、渗井的管网，应考虑设水力旋流分离器去除沉砂和漂浮物
items.condition: networks with pumped discharges or discharge to public amenity areas, ponds and soakaways
items.quote: consideration should be given to the use of hydrodynamic separators to remove settleable solids and floating debris , particularly in networks that have pumped discharges or discharge to public amenity areas; or ponds and soakaways.

items.rule_zh: 分离器应设在操作人员可安全进入处，并有吸污车的安全路外停车位
items.quote: The separators should be located in areas with safe access for the operators to “dip” the central shaft to measure the depth of accumulated sediment and safe off -road parking for the suction tanker for emptying.

items.rule_zh: 涵洞基础须按 100 年一遇洪水冲刷设计，DEPARTMENT 要求时按 500 年一遇校核
items.quote: Pipe and culvert foundations shall be designed to withstand the scour conditions arising from a 1 in 100-year frequency flood event and checked for 1:500-year storm when required by DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 涵洞经 DEPARTMENT/AACM 同意可允许最多 20% 水深的超载
items.quote: Maximum surcharging of 20% of depth may be permitted if agreed with DEPARTMENT/ AACM.

items.rule_zh: 涵洞至少两根管或两孔；除非有安全或保安要求，不设进口格栅
items.quote: The culvert shall consist of a minimum of two pipes or concrete cells as they carry a high risk of blockage during a storm. Inlet bar screens shall not be provided unless there is a specific site safety or security requirement.

items.rule_zh: 受潮位影响的系统须在最高天文潮（HAT）时按表 3-2 重现期不发生内涝，并按高一级重现期校核；出口尾水位取 HAT
items.condition: where discharge could be adversely affected by tide levels
items.quote: the system design shall be carried out  such that no flooding occurs  at the return period stipulated in Table 3-2 at the time of Highest Astronomical Tide (HAT ), and checked for a return period one category higher ... setting the tail water at the outfall to the level of the HAT.

items.rule_zh: 排海口设计见第 2 卷标准图
items.quote: The design of outfalls is shown in Volume 2: Standard Drawings.

items.rule_zh: 最高天文潮 HAT = +1.3 m（NADD）
items.quote: Highest Astronomical Tide (HAT) 1.3

items.rule_zh: 大潮平均高潮位 = +0.7 m（NADD）
items.quote: Mean Spring High Water (MHHW) 0.7

items.rule_zh: 小潮平均高潮位 = +0.2 m（NADD）
items.quote: Mean Neap High Water (MLHW) 0.2

items.rule_zh: 小潮平均低潮位 = −0.2 m（NADD）
items.quote: Mean Neap Low Water (MHLW) -0.2

items.rule_zh: 大潮平均低潮位 = −0.7 m（NADD）
items.quote: Mean Spring Low Water (MLLW) -0.7

items.rule_zh: 最低天文潮 LAT = −1.1 m（NADD）
items.quote: Lowest Astronomical Tide (LAT) -1.1

items.rule_zh: 建议在表 4-5 潮位上加 0.5 m 考虑长期海平面上升；但随后又写设计用高潮位取 +1.3 m（NADD）
items.quote: It is therefore recommended that 0.5m be added to the numbers in Table 4-5 to allow for long-term rising sea levels. In other words, the high tide value of +1.3 m level to NADD should be used for design.

items.rule_zh: 所有排海管的管顶须低于大潮平均低潮位（MLLW = −0.7 m NADD）
items.quote: The soffit of all outfall pipes shall lie below Mean Spring Low Water tide level.

items.rule_zh: 排海口上游须设一个井室，盖板标高高于 HAT（+1.3 m NADD），内设止回阀，保护管网或泵站免受海水倒灌
items.condition: chamber on the pipe upstream of the outfall
items.quote: A chamber shall be located on the pipe upstream of the outfall with cover level at a point above HAT (i.e., above 1.3m – Level to New Abu Dhabi Datum (m) NADD) and shall include non-return valve, such that the network or pumping station is protected by non -return valve against seawater ingress.

items.rule_zh: 止回阀为双铰拍门、柔性鸭嘴阀、锥形阀或拍门闸；须在最小水头差下关闭并防止任何倒流
items.quote: Such valves shall be a double hinged flap valve or a flexible duck-bill or cone type or flap gate. The valves shall close under a minimum of head difference and shall prevent any backflow into the network.

items.rule_zh: 止回阀井室内须设竖向格栅，栅距 100 mm；井室须便于检修和清渣
items.quote: This chamber shall also include a trash screen with vertical bars at 100mm spacing. The chamber shall be located to give good ac cess for maintenance purposes, including the removal of trash.

items.rule_zh: 排海口可另设手动或自动清污格栅，格栅须设在单独井室内
items.quote: Outfall structure may also be provided with a manual or automatic trash screen for removal of debris. Trash bar screen shall be housed in a separate chamber

items.rule_zh: 可能接触海水或稀释海水的材料须按相应耐腐蚀性选用
items.quote: All materials that could come into contact with sea water or diluted sea water shall be specified for the appropriate corrosion resistance.

items.rule_zh: 每个排海口须设防人员进入的安全格栅：直径 20 mm 不锈钢栅条，最大间距 150 mm
items.condition: bars 20mm diameter stainless steel (Abu Dhabi; Al Ain uses galvanized bars)
items.quote: Every outfall structure shall incorporate a safety grill to prevent unauthorised access into the outfall pipe. The grill shall be fabricated from 20mm diameter stainless steel bars and the maximum spacing of bars shall be 150mm.

items.rule_zh: 开挖过深、地质不宜开挖或需穿越道路、铁路、电力线、水体时，可考虑非开挖
items.quote: Such construction may be beneficial where: • An open cut trench would be unacceptably deep for the particular location • The ground conditions are unsuitable for open trenches • A road, railway, powerlines or body of water crossing is required

items.rule_zh: 非开挖方法适用管径：顶管 900–2400 mm 及以上；微型隧道 300–900 mm；螺旋钻 ≤1000 mm；定向钻 300–1500 mm；大管径用 TBM 管片
items.quote: Pipe jacking - diameter 900mm to 2400mm and above • Micro-tunnelling - diameter range 300mm to 900mm • Auger boring – diameters up to 1000mm • Directional drilling - diameter range 300mm to 1500mm

items.rule_zh: 非开挖两端（及可能的中间点）需要较大的工作井/坑占地
items.quote: Note that significant areas are required for working shafts/pits at each end of a trenchless technique and pos sibly at intermediate points depending on length and conditions.

items.rule_zh: 施工方法比选须考虑承包商能力、施工安全、地质、永久及施工占地、环境影响、造价和工期
items.quote: The assessment of preferred method shall consider: • availability of contractor expertise • construction safety • ground conditions • area of land required for the permanent works and construction working areas • environmental impact

items.rule_zh: 管网、井室和泵站可能积聚爆炸性或有毒气体，应设通气管并避免产生静电火花的材料
items.quote: The accumulation of explosive or poisonous gases in the pipe network, chambers and pumping stations. ... Vent stacks to be provided. Avoid specifying materials that could generate sparks from static electricity.

items.rule_zh: 深井须设中间平台或楼梯，并留有将昏迷人员从井底提升至地面的空间
items.quote: Deep manholes Provide intermediate landings or staircases Provide space for lift of unconscious person from base of manhole to ground level

items.rule_zh: 须考虑管网自然或机械通风；残余危险须通过健康安全记录和竣工图报 DEPARTMENT
items.quote: In all cases careful consideration shall be given to the need for natural or forced ventilation of the network to remove any undesirable gases and before man -entry is made for maintenance purposes. In many instances residual hazards will remain and these shall be notified to DEPARTMENT

items.rule_zh: 所有混凝土结构须符合 DEPARTMENT《建筑规范及结构设计与混凝土施工建议》和阿布扎比国际建筑规范用户指南
items.quote: All concrete structures shall be designed to comply with: • DEPARTMENT publication “Building Regulations & Recommendations for Structural Design & Concrete Practices” • User Guide for the International Building Codes in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

items.rule_zh: 新建雨水系统一般不允许用渗井和渗沟；仅在地下水深、渗透性高、维护可行时经研究逐案考虑，设计标准须与 ADM 商定
items.condition: unless groundwater deep, permeability high, maintenance practical; case-by-case study
items.quote: Generally, the use of soakaways and soakaway trenches are not permitted in the design of new storm water systems. However, where the groundwater table is deep, the soil’s permeability is high, and the maintenance requirements are practical, infiltration systems can be considered

items.rule_zh: 渗井按设计重现期（如 10 年）24 h 降雨径流量设计，雨停后 24 h 内渗空
items.condition: design return period (i.e., 1:10-year, or other), 24-hour duration
items.quote: Individual Soakaway systems shall be sized for in filtrating the runoff volume ... from design return period (i.e., 1:10-year, or other), 24-hour duration, stormwater flow to be infiltrated (volume emptied) within a 24-hour period after the end of the storm.

items.rule_zh: 渗井须位于渗透性合适处，底部高出各季节和潮汐周期内最高地下水位至少 1.0 m，并有足够的管线和结构间距
items.condition: above the highest fluctuated groundwater table per geotechnical report
items.quote: Preliminarily locate soakaways as to probable areas where suitably permeable soils exist with sufficient clearance of minimum 1.0 meter above the highest fluctuated groundwater table along period covers all range of seasons and tidal  cycles in accordance to the geotechnical report.

items.rule_zh: 大面积铺装（如长路段）试布置时约每 500 m² 汇水面积设一个渗井
items.quote: establish trial Soakaway locations by providing a Soakaway for approximately each 500 m2 of catchment area.

items.rule_zh: 渗井入渗面只按侧面计（底面假定被淤堵），需在 24 h 内排空；TD>24 h 时须重新配置
items.quote: Infiltration interface areas, or the outer areas of gravel backfill, must be sufficient to provide an infiltration  flow that empties the storage volume within 24 hours after the storm event. ... the infiltration interface surface is based on the sides only.

items.rule_zh: 渗沟至少两个检查清淤口，直线段两端各一，间距不超过 75 m
items.quote: Trench-type soakaways shall have at least two inspection and cleanout ports connected to the perforated pipe, one at each end of a straight trench, no more than 75 m apart.

items.rule_zh: DEPARTMENT 辖区内城区新建雨水系统不允许建明渠和边沟（公路和艾因市除外）
items.quote: Constructed open channels and ditches in urban areas are not permitted in the design of new storm water systems within DEPARTMENT jurisdiction.

items.rule_zh: 塘分为干塘（滞洪塘，雨间通常无水）和湿塘（保留塘，有常水位）
items.quote: Dry pond (detention pond) - A permanent pond that temporarily stores stormwater runoff to control the peak rate of discharge ... These ponds are normally dry between storm events.

items.rule_zh: 城区或近住宅的干塘须考虑景观价值，宜绿化成公园，作浅水景观或湿地
items.condition: dry ponds in urban areas or close to residential developments
items.quote: The amenity value of dry ponds located in urban areas or areas close to residential developments is to be considered.  In these areas consideration should be given to landscaping the area as park land and utilising the pond as a shallow open water feature, or wetland

items.rule_zh: 暴雨后增加的水深应在一周内降回景观水位
items.quote: The increased depth following a storm should be lowered to the amenity level within one week.

items.rule_zh: 郊区干塘应保持干燥并装设在一周内排空的设施，除非经 DEPARTMENT 批准为蒸发塘
items.quote: Dry ponds in rural areas should be dry and facilities installed to empty the pond within one week installed unless DEPARTMENT approval is obtained to an evaporative lagoon.

items.rule_zh: 塘的尺寸须做详细模拟并做环境影响评价；设计须在施工前获所有相关部门批准
items.quote: Detailed modelling shall be carried out for the sizing of the ponds, in addition to environmental impact assessment. The design shall be approved by all concerned authorities prior to construction.

items.rule_zh: 休闲塘如需水处理，由顾问按项目设计并经主管部门批准
items.quote: For recreational ponds, water treatment (if required) shall be designed by the consultant based on project specifics and approved by the concerned authority.

items.rule_zh: 雨水塘不得位于地表水体或其要求的缓冲区内
items.quote: Stormwater ponds must not be located within surface water bodies or any buffer zones required.

items.rule_zh: 进水至出水的建议高差 1.8–2.4 m，小场地可更低
items.condition: lower heads will work at small sites
items.quote: The elevation difference recommended at a site from the inflow to the outflow is 1.8 to 2.4 m, but lower heads will work at small sites.

items.rule_zh: 强烈建议主溢洪道出口设消力池或出口防护，把流速降到 1–1.5 m/s 的不冲刷流速
items.quote: It is Highly Recommended that a stilling basin or outlet protection be used to reduce flow velocities from the principal spillway to non-erosive velocities (1 to 1.5 meter per second).

items.rule_zh: 须提供充足的检修通道，一般最小宽度 5.0 m；视场地条件经工程师批准可接受其他值
items.condition: different values may be accepted based on site conditions upon approval of the engineer
items.quote: Adequate maintenance access, typically with a minimum width of 5.0m, shall be provided, different values may be accepted based on site conditions and upon approval of the engineer.

items.rule_zh: 设前池时应有车辆/设备直达前池用于清淤；远离项目的塘可从地方道路进入
items.quote: Where a forebay is installed, direct vehicle/equipment access should be provided to the forebay for sediment removal and other maintenance activities.

items.rule_zh: 须设应急溢洪道以宣泄超过设计的暴雨，须做防冲加固并符合堰体安全要求
items.quote: An emergency spillway must be provided to pass storms in excess of the pond hydraulic design. The spillway must be stabilized to prevent erosion and designed in accordance with applicable weir safety requirements.

items.rule_zh: 应急溢洪道的位置须使下游构筑物不受溢流影响
items.quote: The emergency spillway must be located so that downstream structures will not be impacted by spillway discharges.

items.rule_zh: 溢洪道穿过检修通道处须选用满足荷载要求的材料
items.condition: if the spillway crosses the maintenance access
items.quote: If the spillway crosses the maintenance access, materials meeting the appropriate load requirements must be selected

items.rule_zh: 塘出口须防止漂浮物排出；进水区应加固以保证高流量时不冲刷
items.quote: Basin outlets must be designed to prevent discharge of floating debris j. Inlet areas should be stabilized to ensure that non-erosive conditions exist during high-flow events

items.rule_zh: 塘设计的各方面都须考虑公共安全
items.quote: Public safety must be considered in every aspect of pond design

items.rule_zh: 强烈建议每个塘设沉砂前池或等效预处理，以土堤、混凝土堰或石笼与常水池隔开；前池出流进入常水池应不冲刷
items.quote: It is highly recommended that each pond have a sediment forebay or equivalent upstream pretreatment. The sediment forebay is a small pool, to be separated from the permanent pool by barriers such as earthen berms, concrete weirs, or gabion baskets

items.rule_zh: 建议前池容积为水质控制容积的 10%
items.quote: It is recommended that the forebay(s) be sized to contain 10 percent of the water quality volume.

items.rule_zh: 建议在前池设固定竖向沉积深度标尺
items.quote: It is recommended that a fixed vertical sediment depth marker be installed in the forebay to measure sediment deposition over time.

items.rule_zh: 蒸发塘/渗透塘排空时间长，须考虑积水和管内淤积；措施可包括进水管底高出塘底至少 30 cm、定期清淤、从末端检查井抽水入塘
items.condition: evaporative and/or percolation ponds; one of several possible measures
items.quote: the issues of standing water and sedimentation in the pipe must be considered.Measurements may include one or all of the following: pipe invert must be at least 30 cm above the pond bottom level, regular maintenance of removing sediments from the pipe

items.rule_zh: 塘水溶解氧须保持在 5 ppm 以上
items.quote: One of the most important water quality parameters is the Dissolved Oxygen (DO) rate, which has to be kept above 5 ppm.

items.rule_zh: 推荐喷泉、表面或潜水（扩散）曝气器；曝气系统需能循环全塘水量，需考虑水深、形状、电源和运行方式
items.quote: Three different types are recommended, fountain aerator, surface aerator, or submerged aerator (diffuser). ... 1. Size – Aeration systems need to be capable of circulating the volume of water in the pond.

items.rule_zh: 曝气器布置应结合水深、主导风向、与电源的距离及加油维护可达性
items.quote: Locating several aerators in a pond should be done according to site factors such as depth, direction of prevailing winds, proximity to electrical power sources, and accessibility for fuelling and maintaining the equipment.

items.rule_zh: 曝气系统按场地逐案选型；机电仪图纸由厂家提供并须经市政当局批准
items.quote: The proper aeration system shall be chosen according to the site condition on a case -by-case basis. Mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation drawings for the aerator system shall be provided by the manufacturer and require the approval of the concerned municipality.

items.rule_zh: 塘的边坡防护和底部衬砌须采用灌浆抛石、土工格室或混凝土土工合成水泥复合板，由合格工程师设计
items.quote: Lagoon side slope protection and bed lining shall be provided using grouted riprap, geocell panels or concrete geo-synthetic cementitious composite sheets. They shall be designed by a suitably qualified and experienced engineer

items.rule_zh: 塘堤稳定须做塘区和出口构筑物钻孔、确定地下水位、核算边坡稳定；辅助溢洪道不应建在堤上
items.quote: ii. Soil boring(s) for embankment basin area and outlet structure. iii. Determination of groundwater elevation. iv. Embankment slopes stability. v. Grassed slopes (maintained). vi. Auxiliary spillway should not be constructed embankment.

items.rule_zh: 公众可到达区域的塘须设围栏或栏杆
items.condition: ponds and lagoons in areas where the public have access
items.quote: Particular attention shall be given to the safety of ponds and lagoons in areas where the public have access. The following safety provisions shall be included: ✓ Protection in the form of fencing or railings

items.rule_zh: 逃生台阶或爬梯间距不超过 100 m，每个塘至少 1 处
items.condition: public access; at least one per pond
items.quote: Steps or ladders located at intervals not exceeding 100m to facilitate escape from the pond/lagoon, with at least one escape point per pond/lagoon.

items.rule_zh: 救生设备（如救生圈）间距不超过 100 m，每个塘至少 1 个
items.condition: public access; at least one per pond
items.quote: Life-saving devices (such as a lifebuoy) shall be positioned at intervals not exceeding 100m, with at least one device per pond/lagoon

items.rule_zh: 警示牌间距不超过 50 m，每个塘至少 2 块
items.condition: public access; at least two per pond
items.quote: Appropriate warning signs at intervals not exceeding 50m, with at least two signs per pond/lagoon.

items.rule_zh: 地下水控制系统最好与雨水系统合并，共用调蓄池、泵站和排海口，以减少占地和环境影响
items.quote: Groundwater control systems are best when combined with the surface water system, so that combined flows are directed to common attenuation tanks, pumping stations and outfalls. These shared arrangements help minimise land use and environmental impacts of separate systems.

items.rule_zh: 阿布扎比沿海地下水位浅，内陆深处超过 150 m；地下水质很差
items.quote: Hydrogeology – shallow water table at the coast and more than 150 m below ground level far inland, low groundwater recharge rate and very poor groundwater quality

items.rule_zh: 须证明已通过现场勘察取得实际地下水位和渗透系数数据（表 5-1 仅作起点）
items.quote: The Consultant will need to demonstrate that data on actual groundwater levels and bulk permeability from site investigations has been obtained.

items.rule_zh: 须考虑城市开发（如新灌溉区）导致将来地下水位上升
items.quote: The Consultant shall demonstrate consideration for groundwater levels to rise in the future due to urban development effects, e.g., from new areas of irrigation.

items.rule_zh: 化粪池：基础埋深 3.0–4.0 m，地下水最小埋深为基础面以下 0.5 m
items.quote: Septic Tanks 3.0 - 4.0 0.5 m below formation level

items.rule_zh: 电信电缆及井室：埋深 0.4–1.5 m，地下水位须在地面以下 2.0 m
items.quote: Telephone Cables and Chambers 0.4 - 1.5 2.0 below Ground Level

items.rule_zh: 电力电缆及井室：埋深 0.4–1.5 m，地下水位须在地面以下 2.0 m
items.quote: Power Cables and Chambers 0.4 - 1.5 2.0 below Ground Level

items.rule_zh: 给水管及井室：埋深 0.9 m，地下水位须在地面以下 1.4 m
items.quote: Potable Water System; Pipes and Chambers 0.9 1.4 below Ground Level

items.rule_zh: 中水（TSE）管及井室：埋深 1.0 m，地下水位须在地面以下 1.5 m
items.quote: TSE System; Pipes and Chambers 1.0 1.5 below Ground Level

items.rule_zh: 道路基层底：埋深 0.3–1.0 m，地下水位须在基层底以下 0.5 m
items.quote: Roads; Formation Level of Base Course 0.3 - 1.0 0.5 m below formation level

items.rule_zh: 建筑基础：埋深 1.0–1.5 m，地下水位须在基础面以下 0.5 m
items.quote: Buildings Foundation Level 1.0 - 1.5 0.5 m below formation level

items.rule_zh: 建筑地下室：埋深 4.0–4.5 m，地下水位须在其底面以下 0.5 m
items.quote: Buildings Basement 4.0 - 4.5 0.5 m below formation level

items.rule_zh: 污水管：最小覆土 1.2 m（公路）/0.9 m（私有地块），地下水位须在地面以下 1.2 m（仅供参考，施工前须由 ADSSC 认可顾问核实）
items.condition: for information only; to be verified prior to construction
items.quote: Sewers * 1.2 cover min (highways) 0.9 cover min (private) 1.2 m below Ground Level * for information only; to be verified by the ADSSC approved consultant prior to any construction activities

items.rule_zh: 降低地下水可能引起建筑沉降；须评估并报 DEPARTMENT，未获其降水科同意不得继续设计
items.quote: The Consultant shall make a n assessment of these impacts and report findings to DEPARTMENT for review. Design shall not proceed until the agreement of DEPARTMENT Dewatering Section has been given.

items.rule_zh: 泵站设计按第 6 节执行
items.quote: Pumping station design shall be carried out in accordance with Section 6.

items.rule_zh: 须收集现有和规划管线资料；排水管线尽量不跨越埋地电缆、管道等设施
items.quote: Information shall be obtained by the Consultant on existing and proposed utilities. As far as possible, drain lines shall not be installed across buried cables, pipelines and other facilities.

items.rule_zh: 泵站造价、运维高且是薄弱环节，只在水力上必需（无法重力排水）时才设置
items.quote: As such, pumping stations should only be incorporated in the system where they are essential for correct hydraulic functioning.

items.rule_zh: 泵站建设、运行、维护昂贵，健康安全风险高于重力系统
items.quote: pumping stations are expensive to construct, operate and maintain, contain additional health and safety risks over gravity systems and have number potential problems that must be considered.

items.rule_zh: 泵站至少包含进水井、泵房、出水井、MCC 室、起吊设备、通风/空调系统（影响占地）
items.quote: Following major pumping station components shall be considered as minimum during the design process: Inlet Chamber, Pump house, Discharge Chamber ... MCC room, Lifting Equipment, Ventilation/ HVAC system

items.rule_zh: 进水井须容纳闸门（penstock）、格栅、沉砂、隔油
items.quote: Inlet chamber shall be design to accommodate following items: Penstock, Screening, Sand Trap, Oil separator

items.rule_zh: 泵房须容纳吸水管（湿井安装）、水泵、出水管及隔离阀、止回阀等
value: Discharge piping incl. isolation valves, check valve
items.quote: each pump house shall be designed to accommodate following items: Suction piping (wet well installation), Pumps, Discharge piping including required isolation valves, check valve, associated piping, etc.

items.rule_zh: 出水井须容纳流量计、管线阀、水锤罐（如需）
items.quote: Discharge chamber shall be design to accommodate Flowmeter, Line Valve, Surge vessel (if required)

items.rule_zh: 排海口泵站常用类型为湿井式（表 6-1）
items.quote: outfall ✓ (Wet Well)

items.rule_zh: 人行地道泵站常用湿井式
items.quote: pedestrian underpasses ✓ (Wet Well)

items.rule_zh: 车行地道泵站常用湿井式
items.quote: traffic underpasses ✓ (Wet Well)

items.rule_zh: 提升泵站、通用泵站（及地下渗排泵站）湿井、干井两种均可
items.condition: lifting stations; pumping station of the general purpose
items.quote: lifting stations ✓ ✓ pumping station of the general purpose ✓ ✓

items.rule_zh: 单泵流量 ≤180 L/s 时用圆形湿井
items.condition: individual pump flow up to 180 l/s -> circular wet well
items.quote: Circular wet wells shall be used for pumps with individual flows up to 180 l/s.

items.rule_zh: 单泵流量 >180 L/s 时设计为矩形湿井
items.condition: individual pump flow greater than 180 l/s -> rectangular wet well
items.quote: Rectangular wet wells shall be designed for large pumps with individual flows greater than 180 l/s.

items.rule_zh: 有效容积为最高启泵水位与最低停泵水位之间的容积；最小容积取决于来水、泵能力、允许循环时间和运行顺序
items.quote: It is the volume defined by the highest start level and lowest stop level in the pump sump.

items.rule_zh: 湿井应至少储存峰值流量下一个最小循环时间的水量（每小时 6–10 次启动，或按厂家规定的最小循环时间 t）
items.condition: or as per minimum allowable cycle time 't' designated by pump manufacturer
items.quote: In general, the wet well should have a storage of a minimum cycle time of peak flow (6:10 starts per hour or as per the minimum allowable cycle time 't' designated by the pump manufacturer)

items.rule_zh: 最小有效容积 V = 0.25·Q·T（Q 泵能力，T 厂家规定最小循环时间）
items.condition: Q = pump capacity; T = minimum cycle time specified by pump manufacturer
items.quote: For minimum active volume calculation following equation shall be used: V=0.25QT Q – Pump capacity T – Minimum cycle time specified by pump manufacturer

items.rule_zh: 多泵时按单泵计算每台泵启停水位间容积，并额外加深使相邻泵启/停水位间距 150 mm
items.condition: multiple pumps installed; between start or stop levels of consecutive pumps
items.quote: additional capacity is required to allow a vertical distance of 150mm between the start or stop levels of consecutive pumps

items.rule_zh: 湿井容积详细要求参照 ANSI-HI 9.8
items.quote: For more details, refer to guidance provided in ANSI-HI_9.8.

items.rule_zh: 干井式泵站：湿井有效容积同上公式；干井尺寸至少考虑设备与管道、安装空间、人员通道、民防要求
items.quote: For the dry well sizing following shall be considered as minimum: Equipment and piping requirement; Sufficient space for installation of the equipment and piping; Adequate access for personnel; Civil Defence requirements

items.rule_zh: 雨水泵一律用离心泵：湿井可用潜水直联泵或潜水轴流泵；干井用潜水直联泵
items.quote: Centrifugal pumps shall be used for all storm water pumping applications as follows: Submersible direct coupled pumps ✓ ✓ Submersible axial (propeller) ✓

items.rule_zh: 多泵站须核对单泵运行工况
items.quote: In multiple pump installations, it is essential that the operating conditions of a single pump running are carefully checked to ensure that the pump will operate satisfactorily.

items.rule_zh: 泵设计流量在最大设计流量基础上另加 10% 余量
items.quote: Pump design flow rates shall be determined from the range of working requirements with an additional allowance of 10% at maximum design flow.

items.rule_zh: 泵特性曲线在关阀到全开之间均稳定，且足够陡以便并联运行
items.quote: The pump performance characteristic shall be: stable at all flow rates between closed valve and open valve; steep enough to permit satisfactory operation in parallel with other pumps

items.rule_zh: 雨水含氯盐、油、砂、塑料杂物，须选用高过固能力、耐磨耐蚀、低转速泵
items.quote: Pumps with high solid passing capacity, wear and corrosion resistance and lower speed drives shall be considered.

items.rule_zh: 选泵时须确定初期与远期的最大、正常、最小流量
items.quote: The required design capacity (both initial and ultimate flows), including the maximum, normal, and minimum flows to be pumped, shall be established during pumping equipment selection.

items.rule_zh: 无专门调蓄（仅有效容积）的泵站：峰值由 2–3 台工作泵承担
items.condition: pumping stations designed without special storage requirement (active volume only)
items.quote: The peak demand should be covered with two or three duty pumps.

items.rule_zh: 正常流量由 1 台工作泵承担
items.condition: pumping stations designed without special storage requirement (active volume only)
items.quote: Normal demand should be covered with one duty pump.

items.rule_zh: 持续最小流量可能要求设置小流量泵以节能、减磨
items.quote: The expected sustained minimum flow is important as it may dictate installation of the low flow pumps to ensure energy saving and wear and tear reduction of the main pumps.

items.rule_zh: 每座泵站至少 2 台泵
items.quote: The minimum required number of pumps in each pumping station is two.

items.rule_zh: 两泵布置：每台按所需流量的 66%–100% 设计（允许放大以补偿单泵故障）
items.quote: For two pump arrangements, pump oversizing to compensate possible pump failure is acceptable each designed to pump 66 to 100% of the required flow.

items.rule_zh: 三泵布置：每台按设计流量的 50% 设计
items.quote: For three pump arrangements each designed to pump 50% of the design flow.

items.rule_zh: 各主泵能力相同、同品牌同型号
items.quote: Each main pump shall have equal capacity and be of the same make and type.

items.rule_zh: 少量大泵时宜设一台小泵最先启动，不参与后续轮换
items.condition: when using a small number of large capacity pumps
items.quote: Low-capacity pump should be used as the first to switch on when using a small number of large capacity pumps. This pump is not part of the sequencing that follows.

items.rule_zh: 受纳水体水位高于排口水位时，排口须设泵站
items.condition: where receiving water bodies are higher than the water level of the outfall
items.quote: Pumping stations shall be provided at outfalls where receiving water bodies are higher than the water level of the outfall.

items.rule_zh: 排海口泵站最大能力由水力模型在设计阶段确定，须经主管市政部门批准
items.quote: The hydraulic modelling shall identify the maximum capacity of such pumping station during the design stage subject to approval by the concerned municipality.

items.rule_zh: 排海口泵站按 10 年一遇设计
items.quote: The Pumping station should be designed based on 1 in 10-year return period.

items.rule_zh: 与重力管并联工作的淹没式排口泵站，最小能力为降雨估算峰值流量的 10%，若与地下水管网合流到同一排口，另加地下水入流
items.condition: submerged outfall pumping stations working in parallel with gravity lines; plus groundwater inflow if both networks combined to same outfall
items.quote: The minimum capacity of the submerged outfall pumping stations working in parallel with gravity lines shall be 10% of estimated peak flow during the rain events in addition to the groundwater inflow if both networks is combined and directed to the same outfall.

items.rule_zh: 调蓄用于削减泵峰值流量、降低运行与初期造价；调蓄与泵能力平衡的设计最经济
items.quote: design that balances storage and pumping capacity provides the most economical design since storage permits use of smaller and/or fewer pumps

items.rule_zh: 总调蓄容积须用入流过程线与泵-系统曲线计算；可比较入流过程线与控制排泵流量估算
items.quote: The Consultant shall calculate total storage capacity to be provided using inflow hydrograph and pump-system curves.

items.rule_zh: 所需调蓄量为最后一台泵启动水位以上、超出泵能力的入流量（图 6-3 阴影面积）
items.quote: The shaded area represents the estimated volume required above the last pump turn-on point – this assumes that this volume of water is beyond the capacity of the pumps and must be stored.

items.rule_zh: 调蓄也可用于降低泵站排放流量，使不超过排口最大能力
items.quote: The storage might also be required to reduce the discharge rate of the pump station and to store enough inflow ... to meet the specified limits and not exceed the maximum capacity of the outfall.

items.rule_zh: 在限制峰值排放或排口能力有限的区域，可选总能力等于目标出流的泵，并计算所需调蓄
items.condition: areas where ordinances limit peak discharges to pre-developed rates, or where the outfall system has limited capacity
items.quote: In this approach, choose pumps that have a total capacity of identified target outflow rate. Compute the required system storage in order to detain the design inflow hydrograph.

items.rule_zh: 首选第三种方法：迭代调蓄容积、泵规格与台数，取全寿命周期成本最小组合
items.quote: The first two approaches do not identify the combination of pump size and storage that minimizes life-cycle costs. Hence, the third approach is preferred.

items.rule_zh: 系统调蓄容积 = 管网、调蓄设施与湿井中最低泵运行高程至最高允许水位之间的容积
items.quote: The system storage Volume is defined as the volume in the collection system, storage unit, and wet well between the lowest pump operation elevation and the maximum allowable high water serves to detain the inflow.

items.rule_zh: 调蓄估算步骤：选设计入流过程线→试定目标总泵量→从涨水段切线画出流线至退水段等于目标泵量处→两线间面积即所需容积（详见 HEC-24 第 6 章）
items.quote: Step 4. The area between the estimated pumping rate line and hydrographer presents the estimated required volume. For more details, refer to (HEC-24, Chapter 6)

items.rule_zh: 比转速 <5200（美制 4500）的泵，优选运行区 POR 为 BEP 的 70%–120%
items.condition: specific speed less than 5200 (4500 U.S units)
items.quote: The POR for pumps with a specific speed less than 5200 (4500 U.S units) shall be from 70% to 120% of BEP.

items.rule_zh: 比转速更高的泵，POR 为 BEP 的 75%–115%
items.quote: For higher specific speeds POR shall be from 75% to 115% of Best Efficiency Point (BEP).

items.rule_zh: 正常/常见工况运行点应在 POR 内并尽量靠近 BEP；最大工况可在 POR 外但须在 AOR 内（按 ANSI/HI 9.6.3）
items.quote: During normal operation or frequent operating conditions pump operation point should be located within Preferred Operating Region (POR) as close possible to Best Efficiency Point (BEP).

items.rule_zh: 有效汽蚀余量 NPSHa ≥ 必需汽蚀余量 NPSHr + 1.5 m
items.quote: NPSHa ≥NPSHr +1.5 m

items.rule_zh: 吸水管按 ANSI/HI 9.8 及厂家建议设计
items.quote: Design of the suction piping shall follow ANSI/HI 9.8 Pump Intake Design standard and selected pump manufacturer recommendations.

items.rule_zh: 进泵吸水管应为直管，长度 5D–10D（理想 10D）
items.quote: Suction piping approaching to pump should be straight with length from 5D to 10D | Ideally, length of the suction pipe should be 10D.

items.rule_zh: 避免管件直连泵口、避免短半径弯头、避免底阀；用闸阀作关断阀；变径用顶平偏心大小头；吸水管不得小于泵吸入口
items.quote: Installation of foot valves shall be avoided | Gate valves shall be used as shut off valves ... The suction line size shall never be smaller than suction nozzle size

items.rule_zh: 最低泵送流速须足以避免固体堵塞吸水管（未给数值）
items.quote: Minimum pumping velocity shall be sufficient to avoid clogging of the suction line due to presence of the solids in the water

items.rule_zh: 出水管径不小于泵出口直径，出水流速 1.5–2.5 m/s
items.quote: Discharge pipe should be at least as large as the pump discharge diameter | discharge velocity range from 1.5 to 2.5 m/s

items.rule_zh: 出水管应尽量短而简单，最简单为每台泵独立出水管
items.quote: Discharge line should be kept as short and simple as possible | Simplest configuration with pump has its own independent discharge line

items.rule_zh: 泵竖向立管弯头应高于出水管并向出口端下坡，以减少停泵回流量
items.quote: The elbow of the vertical riser from the pump should be set higher than the discharge line with a slope down to the discharge end | To minimise the volume of back flow when the pumps switch off

items.rule_zh: 可行时，各出水管中心线应高于设计回水位
items.quote: The centreline of each discharge pipe should be placed higher than the design backwater elevation | Where it is practicable

items.rule_zh: 出水管末端中心线低于受纳构筑物设计回水位时，每条出水管末端须设拍门防倒灌
items.condition: if the centreline elevation at the end of the discharge pipe is below the design backwater elevation in the receiving structure
items.quote: A flap gate shall be placed at the end of each discharge line | To prevent back flow if the centreline elevation at the end of the discharge pipe is below the design backwater elevation in the receiving structure

items.rule_zh: 独立出水管过长、过贵时，各泵出水汇入公共集水总管，按可接受流速输送合流
items.condition: where excessive length and cost makes individual discharge lines impracticable
items.quote: Connect the individual pump discharges into a common discharge header sized to direct the combined flow at an acceptable velocity in pumping main | Where excessive length and cost makes individual discharge lines impracticable

items.rule_zh: 每台泵出水管必须设止回阀
items.quote: Each pump discharge line must include a check valve | to prevent recirculation of flow

items.rule_zh: 进水结构须使各泵进水均匀，按最新 ANSI/HI 9.8 设计；避免流速分布差、旋流、掺气、NPSHa 不足、漩涡等
items.quote: The intake structure shall be designed to supply an even distribution of flow to the pumps. ... The pump intake shall be designed according to the latest version Hydraulic Institute standard ANSI/HI 9.8

items.rule_zh: 须设经 U 形槽取放的双层可拆卸格栅保护水泵
items.quote: Removable bar screens handled through U-channel shall be provided for pump protection and shall be double layer type.

items.rule_zh: 格栅须设在格栅井或与湿井分开的井室内；仅 10–30 L/s 的小型湿井泵站可装在湿井内（影响占地）
items.condition: screens may be in wet well only for small wet well pumping stations with capacity 10–30 l/s
items.quote: Screens shall be fitted in trash rack well or within chambers separate from wet well. In case of small wet well pumping stations with capacities in range from 10l/s to 30 l/s, screens can be installed within the wet well.

items.rule_zh: 格栅最大开孔 50×50 mm，最终按泵过固能力选定
items.quote: Maximum opening size of the bar screen shall be 50x50 mm. Final selection of the screens shall be based on the selected pump solid passing capacity.

items.rule_zh: 顾问须判断是否需水锤防护；允许：带胶囊压力罐、浸管罐、软启动或变频，经 DEPARTMENT 批准；不允许用空气阀作水锤控制
value: Soft starters or variable frequency drives
items.quote: employ one of the following permitted systems subject to approval of DEPARTMENT. Pressure vessel with bladder; Dip-tube vessel; Soft starters or variable frequency drives. Air valves as a method of surge control are not permitted.

items.rule_zh: 电气设备用房须为地面以上的独立建筑；仅因业主/特殊要求可设于地下（影响地面占地）
items.condition: can be below ground due to client/special requirement
items.quote: The structure containing the electrical equipment shall be above ground and in a separate building. Due to client/special requirement, the structure can be below ground.

items.rule_zh: 电气室至少两台互相独立的分体空调，每台按需求的 150% 选型（一台故障另一台提供 75%）
items.quote: Minimum two split AC units working independently ... Each split AC should be rated at 50% above the required capacity (i.e. 150% total), so that should one unit fail, the other unit will provide 75% of the required air conditioning capacity.

items.rule_zh: 电机：鼠笼感应电机 400V 三相 50Hz；连续最大额定至少比各工况最大计算功率高 10%；防护 IP68、F 级绝缘以上
items.quote: Continuous maximum rating At least 10% above the calculated maximum power requirements under all conditions of operation ... Protection IP68 class F, as a minimum

items.rule_zh: 直接启动仅允许用于 ≤2 kW 电机（或按 ADDC 要求）
items.quote: Direct on-line starter is allowed for motors up to 2 kW or as per ADDC requirement.

items.rule_zh: 4 kW 以上电机必须用软启动
items.quote: Soft starters are mandatory for motors above 4 kW.

items.rule_zh: MCC 短路容量 50 kA/s 或按 ADDC 要求；配合类型 Type-2；须覆盖含备用在内的总连接负荷
items.quote: The short circuit capacity shall be 50kA/sec or as per ADDC requirement. ... Type of coordination shall be Type-2.

items.rule_zh: MCC 内部分隔：地面以上用 Form-2B；地下（业主要求）用 Form-4B，并设防淹探测和地面断电（分励脱扣）
items.condition: above ground: Form-2B; below ground: Form-4B with anti-flood detector and above-ground power cut-off
items.quote: If the MCC is located above ground, Form-2B should be considered. If the MCC is located below ground, due to client/special requirement, Form-4B,with anti-flood detector and above-ground power cut-off including shunt trip, should be considered

items.rule_zh: MCC、MDB、DB 须符合最新 ADDC 要求
items.quote: The MCC, Main Distribution Board (MDB) and Distribution Board (DB) shall comply with the latest ADDC requirements.

items.rule_zh: 功率因数补偿后整体功率因数 ≥0.93（滞后）；补偿柜强制通风时 ≥IP43，并预留一级等容量备用
items.quote: PFCC shall improve the overall power factor of the plant/equipment to 0.93 lagging (or better) ... The IP rating when fitted with forced ventilation must be at least IP43

items.rule_zh: 所有金属部件接地，按 ADDC 规定；设分隔接地系统（电子、电气安全、电话、防雷）
items.quote: All the metallic parts shall be earthed. ... Earthing shall be designed in accordance with ADDC regulations

items.rule_zh: 防雷器峰值放电电流 ≥10 kA（8/20 μs）；230V 系统残压峰值 ≤600 V
items.condition: let-through voltage <= 600 V for 230 V nominal
items.quote: Protection shall be rated for a peak discharge current of no less than 10kA (8/20-microsecond waveform) ... the peak transients let-through voltage must not exceed 600V for protectors with a nominal working voltage of 230V

items.rule_zh: 一般照度测量面为地面以上 1000 mm；至少 30% 灯具为应急灯；断电时至少 4 h 照明；两门可进入区域设双控开关
items.quote: At least 30% of all lighting fittings shall be emergency light fittings ... arranged to give at least 4 hours illumination in the event of mains power supply failure

items.rule_zh: UPS 独立自动运行，供全部仪表与控制设备、应急照明等
items.quote: The UPS shall be sized to supply all instrumentation and control equipment, including but not limited to, control and computer room hardware, mimic, annunciation, telecommunication systems and emergency lighting etc.

items.rule_zh: 低压电缆为 600/1000V 铜芯；不允许单独中性线电缆；电缆路由须与 DEPARTMENT 商定
items.quote: All LV cables shall be 600/1000V-grade copper single/multi cores ... final routes and duct locations agreed with DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 须设移动发电机接线箱以备市电故障；隧道提升泵站须设固定发电机
items.condition: stationary generator for tunnel lifting pumping station
items.quote: A mobile generator junction box shall be provided for mobile generator connection in case of mains power supply failure. A stationary generator shall be provided for tunnel lifting pumping station.

items.rule_zh: 湿井允许液位计（表 6-8）：浮球、超声波、静压式（湿井列打勾）
items.condition: wet well application per Table 6-8 (column alignment of extracted text uncertain)
items.quote: Summary of permitted level sensor applications is shown in Table 6-8.

items.rule_zh: 允许流量测量方法：超声多普勒、超声时差、电磁、互相关、桨片开关、雷达多普勒、堰、槽（表 6-9），由顾问按现场正确选用
items.quote: Summary of permitted methods of flow measurement is shown in Table 6-9. Consultant is responsible for correct application of the method to the site conditions.

items.rule_zh: 远传仪表须支持 HART / Profibus / Foundation Fieldbus / Modbus 之一与中央系统通信
items.quote: instruments with transmitters shall be able to communicate with a central control system via one of the following communication protocols: HART, Profibus, Foundation Fieldbus, Modbus

items.rule_zh: 泵控制须基于湿井液位；偏离须事先获 DEPARTMENT 批准
items.quote: Pump control shall be based on level in the wet well. Where deviation from this philosophy is deemed necessary, prior approval shall be obtained from DEPARTMENT.

items.rule_zh: 最低联锁：干转（湿井低液位）、出水阻塞/阀关、轴承温度、绕组温度（PT100）、振动
items.quote: Dry run Wet well low level, via level instrument in the suction Wet well ... Pump/Pump Motor vibration Vibration sensors such as accelerometers

items.rule_zh: 每座泵站设 PLC 与 RTU 于同一柜内，门上设 HMI，配电池后备；RTU 主控、PLC 无缝接管
items.quote: Each pumping station location shall be provided with a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and Remote Terminal unit (RTU). Both PLC and RTU shall be installed within the same cubicle.

items.rule_zh: 信号分配器、PLC 与 RTU IO 端子及接线须预留 25% 备用 IO
items.quote: The signal splitters, PLC and RTU IO terminal blocksand wiring shall be provided with 25% spare IO capacity above the design requirement.

items.rule_zh: 泵站与 SCADA 通信采用 GPRS/3G 或光纤，视当地服务而定
items.condition: based on availability of service in the area
items.quote: The facility for communication between the pumping station and SCADA system shall be by GPRS/3G telephone line or fibre optic cable, based on the availability of service in the area

items.rule_zh: 所有结构按 ACI 318 或等效标准设计
items.quote: All structures shall be designed to the required standards of ACI 318 – "Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete" or equivalent.

items.rule_zh: 压力管设计须说明已考虑表7-1各因素（检修通道、树木与其他管线、公用走廊、最短线路、其他设施与建筑位置、规划与环保、最小/最大覆土等）
items.quote: The Consultant shall demonstrate due consideration of the factors in Table 7-1 in the design of pumping main.

items.rule_zh: 压力管最小坡度 1:500（引 BS EN 805 建议）
items.quote: 7 Minimum gradient is 1:500 as per the recommendation of BS EN 805

items.rule_zh: 压力管穿越道路和铁路须为 90 度正交
items.quote: 9 Crossing of roads and railways to be 90 degrees

items.rule_zh: 压力管采用最短可行线路
items.quote: 10 Adoption of shortest practical route

items.rule_zh: 压力管设计须考虑公用管线走廊、其他管线/建筑/构筑物位置、与树根及其他管线的相互损害风险
items.quote: 5 Risk of damage to and from trees, tree roots and other utilities. ... 8 Utility corridors ... 11 Location of other services, buildings and structures

items.rule_zh: 埋地压力管须确定最小覆土深度，并考虑便于维修的最大覆土深度（本条未给数值）
items.quote: 19 For buried pipes the minimum depth of cover 20 The maximum depth of cover for ease of repair

items.rule_zh: 雨水压力管材质须为球墨铸铁、GRP 或 HDPE；阀室及泵站内管件为球墨铸铁（Al Ain 地区可另考虑 uPVC）
items.condition: pipework within valve chambers and pumping stations: ductile iron
items.quote: Piping for storm water pumping mains shall be ductile iron, GRP or HDPE and the pipework within valve chambers and pumping stations is to be ductile iron.

items.rule_zh: 压力管管径应使最小流量时流速约 1 m/s
items.quote: Pipe diameter shall be such that velocity will be in the range of 1 m/s at minimum flow and 2.0 m/s under peak flow.

items.rule_zh: 压力管峰值流量时流速 2.0 m/s
items.quote: Pipe diameter shall be such that velocity will be in the range of 1 m/s at minimum flow and 2.0 m/s under peak flow.

items.rule_zh: 应急工况（如备用泵投入防淹）压力管最大流速 2.5 m/s
items.condition: emergency scenarios, e.g. standby pumps brought online
items.quote: A maximum velocity of 2.5 m/s in emergency scenarios, for example, to avoid flooding where additional standby pumps are brought online.

items.rule_zh: 单泵出水管流速 1.5–2.5 m/s
items.quote: Single pump discharge pipes shall be sized such that the discharge velocities in these pipes will be in the range of 1.5 to 2.5 m/s

items.rule_zh: 吸水总管流速 0.8–1.5 m/s
items.quote: suction headers shall be sized to achieve a velocity in the range of 0.8 to 1.5 m/s.

items.rule_zh: 是否采用双管应逐案考虑，因素包括用地是否允许双管及其阀室、风险评估（爆管后果、敏感受体、临时导流可行性）和成本效益（含土地成本）
items.quote: The use of twin mains should be considered on a case-by-case basis. The main factors for consideration include design elements, the risk assessment and cost benefit analysis.

items.rule_zh: 双管方案成本效益分析应包括管道、土地、能耗等有形成本及扰民等无形因素；考虑双管所需用地
items.quote: The cost benefit analysis should include all tangible factors (such as cost of pipework, land costs, energy cost) and intangible factors (such as nuisance).

items.rule_zh: 若需双管（管径可不同），宜两条均作工作管而非一用一备
items.quote: it is advisable to use both mains as duty rather than one as duty and the other as standby from an economical and operational point of view.

items.rule_zh: 管道须能承受低于大气压 80 kPa 的瞬变负压（约 20 kPa 绝对压力）
items.quote: In accordance to BS EN 805 standard, pipelines shall be designed to withstand a transient pressure of 80 kPa below atmospheric pressure (approximately 20 kPa absolute pressure).

items.rule_zh: 压力管须按 10–50°C 连续运行设计，柔性管需做高温降额
items.quote: Pressure mains shall be designed for continuous operation over the anticipated temperature range of 10 – 50°C. Note that de-rating factors will need to be applied to flexible pipes for the high temperature.

items.rule_zh: 阀门、转向等不平衡力须由足量约束接头、镇墩或其他锚固平衡；镇墩抵靠土体时须确定安全承载力
items.quote: Unbalanced forces (forces at valves, changes in direction, etc.) shall be compensated by an adequate number of restrained joints, thrust blocks or other anchorages.

items.rule_zh: 镇墩最小摩擦安全系数 1.5
items.quote: minimum friction safety factor 1.5

items.rule_zh: 镇墩最小抗滑安全系数 2.0
items.quote: minimum sliding safety factor 2.0

items.rule_zh: 镇墩最小抗倾覆安全系数 2.0
items.quote: minimum overturning safety factor 2.0

items.rule_zh: 阀门须按最高温度、最高瞬变压力选型；不允许泄漏；须核查流速以免气蚀
items.quote: Pressure: The valve must be rated for the highest transient pressure that might be expected • Shutoff: The degree of allowable shutoff must be known. No leakage must be allowed.

items.rule_zh: 须设足够泄空阀，使受影响管段排空时间不超过 4 h（14,400 s）
items.quote: Sufficient washouts must be provided to limit the draining time of the section affected to a maximum of 4 h (14,400 s).

items.rule_zh: 手动阀门 DN≥350 须配齿轮箱
items.quote: valves with a size ≥ DN 350 shall be provided with a gearbox

items.rule_zh: 泵站内隔离阀须配电动执行器
items.quote: power actuators shall be provided for isolation valves in pumping stations

items.rule_zh: 设备隔离用闸阀；在线设备上下游均设隔离阀，离线设备仅上游设一个
items.quote: Gate valves shall be specified for equipment isolation. In line equipment shall have isolating valves upstream and downstream. Off-line equipment require only one isolating valve located upstream.

items.rule_zh: 湿井泵、管井泵、自吸泵出水侧须设隔离阀
items.quote: Wet well pumps, tubewell pumps and self -priming pumps shall have isolating valves at the discharge side.

items.rule_zh: 每台泵出口及带旁通的调压罐须设止回阀
items.quote: Check valves shall be specified at the discharge of each pump and in surge vessels fitted with bypass.

items.rule_zh: 出水井和排水口须设拍门、柔性鸭嘴阀或锥形止回阀
items.quote: Flap valves, flexible duckbill check valve or cone type check valveshall be provided at discharge chambers and outfalls.

items.rule_zh: 部分淹埋、易被泥沙阻碍拍门的出口，建议用止回阀；空间受限的检查井内管口亦建议用止回阀
items.condition: outlet partially buried where sediment may prevent flap gates functioning
items.quote: Are recommended at outlet (partially buried) where sediment may prevent Flap Gates from functioning, as they will operate with higher efficiency.

items.rule_zh: 止回阀开启压力建议 200–450 mm
items.quote: Must have a wide range of opening pressure (recommended 200 to 450 mm), Closing pressure (recommended (60mm to 250 mm), and Maximum Back pressure (recommended 5 m to 8 m of water)

items.rule_zh: 止回阀关闭压力建议 60–250 mm
items.quote: Closing pressure (recommended (60mm to 250 mm)

items.rule_zh: 止回阀最大背压建议 5–8 m 水柱
items.quote: Maximum Back pressure (recommended 5 m to 8 m of water)

items.rule_zh: 止回阀不允许竖向安装（与同节“可安装于竖管”相矛盾）
items.quote: – Could be installed on vertical pipes ... – Installation of check valves in vertical position is not permitted.

items.rule_zh: 止回阀须完全密封防倒流，停流后不得冲击（slam）
items.quote: – Must be Completely tight to prevent backflow ... – Check valves shall avoid slamming after flow stoppage

items.rule_zh: 排气阀间距 1.0 km，并在每个高点和泵出水管设置

items.quote: Air valves shall be specified at 1.0km intervals and the following locations: • At any pipeline high point • in pump discharge lines

items.rule_zh: 阀室应避免设在车行道内，宜设于路肩绿化带或人行道，须遵守公用管线走廊

items.rule_zh: 所有阀室须为钢筋混凝土
items.quote: 2 All chambers shall be designed of reinforced concrete

items.rule_zh: 阀室盖板标高须与周边完成地面齐平（另有规定除外）
items.quote: 3 The cover level of the valve chambers shall be flushed with surrounding finished ground level unless otherwise specified.

items.rule_zh: 阀室底板最小坡度 2%
items.quote: 4 The bottom of the chamber shall have a minimum slope of 2%

items.rule_zh: 深度 >3.0 m 的阀室须设 GRP 爬梯；<3.0 m 可用爬梯或踏步

items.rule_zh: 阀室两侧须设两个柔性接头加摇摆短管以防不均匀沉降（HDPE 实壁管不需要）
items.condition: not required for HDPE solid wall piping
items.quote: 7 Two flexible joints, with a "rocker pipe" shall be provided on either side of the chamber to avoid damaging pipework in case of differential settlement. Rocker pipes are not required for HDPE solid wall piping.

items.rule_zh: 阀室墙至设备最小净距 500 mm
items.quote: 9 A minimum clearance of 500 mm from the walls of the chamber to the equipment shall be provided

items.rule_zh: 阀室墙至接头最小净距 500 mm
items.quote: 10 A minimum clearance of 500 mm from the walls of the chamber to the joints shall be provided.

items.rule_zh: 阀室底板至管内底最小净距 400 mm
items.quote: 11 A minimum clearance of 400 mm from the floor of the chamber to the invert level of the pipe shall be provided.

items.rule_zh: 阀室须有带吊钩的可拆盖板便于吊装设备，须有足够工作空间、通道及排气管自然通风
items.quote: 12 All chambers must have a removable cover with lifting hooks for easy installation and repair. The chamber construction and cover shall facilitate the lifting of equipment.

items.rule_zh: 采用非约束管系时阀室须按阀门关闭时的全部推力设计，管件以止水法兰固定于墙

items.rule_zh: 路边沟期望纵坡：有路缘石路面不小于 0.3%，极平坦地形不小于 0.2%
items.condition: kerbed pavements; 0.2% in very flat terrain
items.quote: Desirable gutter grades should not be less than 0.3 percent for kerbed pavements, and not less than 0.2 percent in very flat terrain.

items.rule_zh: 路肩沟中间进水口旁通流量不应超过 25%；末端进水口须截流 100%
items.quote: Bypass should not exceed 25 percent for intermediate inlets. The terminal inlet must be assured of intercepting 100 percent of the flow coming to it, including bypass from intermediate inlets.

items.rule_zh: 最后一个中间进水口至末端进水口距离不应超过 70 m
items.quote: In any case, the distance from the last intermediate inlet to the terminal inlet should not exceed 70 metres.

items.rule_zh: 设计条件下，<80 km/h 城市多车道路缘路，积水不得超过靠路缘车道；单车道匝道至少 2.5 m 不淹；≥80 km/h 带路肩道路设计径流不得侵入行车道
items.quote: However, flooding shall never exceed the lane adjacent to the kerb or shoulder for design conditions. ... For single -lane roadways ... at least 2.5 metres of roadway shall remain unflooded for design conditions.

items.rule_zh: 带格栅的路缘进水口允许设计能力不得超过公式计算值的 50%–60%（防堵塞）
items.condition: kerb inlets with grates; grated gutter inlets
items.quote: kerb inlets with grates are subject to clogging and the allowable desig n capacity should never be more than 50% - 60 % of the capacity calculated by the following formula

items.rule_zh: 格栅进水口采用的效率只应为计算能力的 50%–60%，并须考虑旁通流量去向
items.quote: In any case, the efficiency used should be only 50% - 60% of the calculated capacity. The Consultant should also be aware of what happens to the bypass flows, and take care of them accordingly.

items.rule_zh: 洼地格栅进水口由堰流向孔流过渡的水深约 120–430 mm
items.quote: The transition zone from weir flow to orifice flow for gutter inlets in sump locations is typically between a depth of about 120mm to 430mm.

items.rule_zh: 低点（洼地）处组合进水口应按仅路缘开口能力计（剔除格栅）
items.quote: it is appropriate to delete the grate from the kerb inlet and assume a combination inlet at a sump will be limited by the kerb-opening capacity.

items.rule_zh: 进水口连接管直线敷设，最小均匀坡度 1%；快速路等最小管径 300 mm
items.quote: a. Inlet connection shall be installed i n straight alignment on a minimum uniform slope of 1 percent. Minimum sizes of pipes for expressways, freeways, and motorways shall measure 300 mm in diameter.

items.rule_zh: 每个检查井最多接 4 个进水口
items.quote: b. Maximum number of inlets connect to a manhole is four.

items.rule_zh: 进水口连接管最大长度 35 m
items.quote: c. Maximum length of inlet connection drains is 35 m.

items.rule_zh: 格栅不得设在车轮轨迹上；避免设在人行道/自行车道
items.quote: d. Drainage structure grates shall never be placed directly in the wheel path. e. Locating grate inlets within pedestrian paths, or areas subject to bicycle traffic, shall also be avoided.

items.rule_zh: 拟建雨水管线和检查井须遵循 DPM 阿布扎比基础设施框架规划与公用管线走廊设计手册或 DoT 管线分布手册
items.quote: g. Proposed Stormwate r drainage pipe lines and manholes shall follow the proposed by DPM – Abu Dhabi Infrastructure Framework plan and Utility Corridors location Design Manual and Design or the proposed Utility distribution Manual of DoT.

items.rule_zh: 土质明渠最大边坡 3H:1V（视土质和岩土勘察），否则须用抛石或混凝土衬砌
items.quote: Generally for all ditches, the maximum side slope of earth channels shall be 3 horizontal to 1 vertical (3h: 1v), depending on the soil type and geotechnical study requirements. Otherwise the ditch shall be lined using riprap or concrete.

items.rule_zh: 大型导流或主排水渠不得平行于道路设置，除非退让至少净区距离（按道路几何设计手册），否则须设护栏
items.condition: larger diversion or main outfall channels
items.quote: Larger diversion or main outfall channels shall not be located parallel to the roadway, unless it is offset by at least the clear zone distance, as required by the Road Geometric Design Manual. Otherwise, the traffic shall be protected by use of guardrail or traffic barrier.

items.rule_zh: 明沟和排水口须设平台（berm）等便于维护的实体通道设施
items.quote: Ditches and outfalls must be provided with beams and other physical access devices that facilitate maintenance activities.

items.quote: Minimum channel slopes are typically 0.3 percent for roadside collectors, medians, and main outfall channels. ... Minimum flushing velocity for lined channels is 0.6 m per second. Minimum velocity for bare earth channels shall not be less than 0.4 m per second.

items.quote: Open-channel drainage systems shall be sized to handle design storms, as mentioned in Table 1.3 with a 0.3-m freeboard.

items.quote: Type of Ditch Design storm return period (years)* ... Ditches – roadside, median, and interceptor ... Freeways, expressways, and arterials: 10 years

items.quote: Design Engineer shall check the 50 -year design storm hydraulics for main diversion and outfall channels. Routing analysis through the channel system shall determine if the 50-year frequency storm flow levels impacts any adjacent structures

items.rule_zh: 大型导流/排水渠弯道中心线最小半径取 2 倍设计水面宽或 7.5 m（路边集水沟）、15 m（低速排水沟）、30 m（高速排水渠）中较大者
items.quote: Minimum radius ... for bends, measured along the channe l centreline, is two times the top width for design flow or a minimum radius of 7.5 m for roadside collector ditches, 15 m for low -velocity outfall ditches, and 30 m for high -velocity outfall channels, whichever is greater.

items.rule_zh: 流态扰动处（含雨水管出口）须做渠道稳定防护，范围通常至少为过渡段上下游各 2.5 倍渠底宽
items.condition: contractions, drops, junctions, expansions, storm drain outlets
items.quote: Channel stabilisation (rock riprap or other lining) shall be provided where there is any flow disturbance ... Typically this will be at least 2.5 times the channel bottom width up- and downstream of the actual channel transition area.

items.rule_zh: 弯道半径小于最小值或流速超限时须设抛石护坡，建议纵向范围为弯道两端各 1.5 倍渠底宽
items.condition: radius smaller than minimum or velocity exceeds allowable
items.quote: If the radius is smaller than the minimum, or velocities exceed that allowable for the natural or lining type, then rock riprap revetment protection shall be installed. Recommended longitudinal extent of protection is 1.5 times the width of channel bottom

items.rule_zh: 公共区域未设围栏的导流/排水明渠，边坡不陡于 3H:1V，流速在裸土渠允许值内，位于道路净区内时设计水深不超过 1.3 m
items.condition: open diversion and outfall channels in public areas not otherwise fenced; depth limit in vehicle clear zone
items.quote: Safety provisions for open diversion and outfall channels in public areas, not otherwise fenced, require side slopes no steeper then 3h:1v (easy for people to climb out of), design velocities within the allowable velocit ies for bare earth channels

items.rule_zh: 陡槽出口流速 >4.5 m/s 时可增设消能结构（如消力池）；<4.5 m/s 可用抛石、灌浆抛石、砾石或块石
items.quote: energy dissipation structure (e.g., stilling basin) may be added at chute outlet due to high exist velocity (more than 4.5 m/s).

items.rule_zh: 涵洞最小尺寸：横穿 600 mm；中央/侧向排水 500 mm（有格栅与沉砂时 300 mm）；箱涵预制 900×900、现浇 1200×1200；高填方进水口排水 300 mm
items.quote: Minimum culvert sizes shall meet the requirements of Table A5-5. Culvert type Minimum size (mm diameter) Cross drain** 600 Median drain 500* Side drain 500* Box culvert 900 by 900 precast 1,200 by 1,200 cast-in situ

items.rule_zh: 圆管/箱涵设计流量下 HW/D ≤1.25；场地条件允许时可更大，但绝不超过 3
items.condition: circular and box culverts, design flow
items.quote: Circular and box culverts shall be designed such that the ratio of the HW to diameter (D) during the design flow event is less than or equal to 1.25 (HWi/D ≤ 1.25). ... The maximum allowable HWi/D ratio shall never exceed 3.

items.rule_zh: 出口受潮汐影响时，下游水位取平均高潮位；排入水库、wadi、潮汐湾等大型水体时，可取同频率暴雨对应的高水位
items.quote: For culverts discharging to a reservoir, wadi, tidal bay, or other major water body; the expected high water elevation ... may establish the culvert TWL. • Where tidal conditions occur at the outlet, the mean high water shall be used.

items.rule_zh: 出口流速应与现有渠道流速接近，否则应改设计降低出口流速或设消能设施
items.quote: c. Outlet flows shall closely match the velocity of the existing channel. If they do not, an alternate culvert design that reduces the outlet velocity or uses energy dissipaters shall be considered

items.rule_zh: 涵洞出口边坡防护：高于涵顶 5D、开口两侧各 1D；进口防护高至设计水头、两侧各 2D
items.quote: b. Install rock riprap , geo -cell panels, or concrete geo-synthetic cementicious composite sheets on outlet slope to a height equal to 5D above the top of the culvert and width of 1D on each side of the culver opening.

items.rule_zh: 跨海峡、海湾等潮汐水道的桥梁须考虑正常潮汐交换、风暴潮和波浪作用

items.condition: new projects or modification to an existing project
items.quote: Federal Law 24) requires all projects or establishments to obtain an environmental permit prior to the commencement of site activities. This is required for new projects or a modification to an existing project.

items.rule_zh: EAD 可要求海洋与水质调查及水动力研究与建模（含基线数据采集）
items.quote: For this type of project the EAD may request marine and water quality surveys and hydrodynamic studies and modelling. This would likely involve the collection of baseline data, modelling and reporting.

items.rule_zh: 新项目须向 TCA-AD 提交 PCR 申请（考古状况），无 TCA-AD 批准不发环境许可
items.quote: In order to permit new projects it is a requirement of this law that a PCR application is made to TCA-AD detailing the project. ... Without the approval of TCA-AD, the Project will not receive an environmental permit

items.rule_zh: 排海口的雨水与海水水质监测要求由 EAD 在环评许可时确定；具体排海口应征询主管部门
items.quote: Further stormwater quality and marine water quality monitoring requirements will be determined by the EAD during the environmental permitting of the outfall. Furthermore, DEPARTMENT may have stormwater monitoring and reporting requirements for specific outfalls and should be consulted in each case.

items.rule_zh: 所有设施宜设周界安全围栏，门窗关锁，限制非授权进入并张贴标识
items.quote: Perimeter and Access Control: restrict access to the critical components of wastewater system to authorized people only, Post sign restricting entry to authorized personnel only. All facilities should have a security fence around the perimeter

items.rule_zh: 设施周围须有充足外部照明、警示标识，关键部件周围不得堆放物品；安防须符合安全规定与消防规范
items.quote: ... comply with safety regulations and fire codes. Adequate external lighting to be around facilities, Warning signs (against tampering, unauthorized access) to be posted at all facilities and critical components. Area around critical components to be free of objects.
